use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tauri::{AppHandle, State};

use crate::core::{
    error::AppError,
    scenario_service,
    skill_store::SkillStore,
    sync_engine, sync_metadata, tool_adapters,
    tool_service,
};
use serde::Serialize;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct SkillToolToggleDto {
    pub tool: String,
    pub display_name: String,
    pub installed: bool,
    pub globally_enabled: bool,
    pub enabled: bool,
}

fn disabled_tools(store: &SkillStore) -> Vec<String> {
    tool_service::get_disabled_tools(store)
}

/// Sync commands fire one call per `(skill, agent)` pair when PresetBar
/// applies a preset from the in-app workspace view. Route through the
/// coalescing refresh so a burst rebuilds the tray at most once per window
/// instead of once per row.
fn schedule_tray_refresh(app: &AppHandle) {
    crate::schedule_tray_refresh(app);
}

fn sync_skill_to_tool_internal(
    store: &SkillStore,
    skill_id: &str,
    tool: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    scenario_service::sync_single_skill_to_tool(
        store,
        skill_id,
        tool,
        scenario_service::DeployIntent::Managed,
    )
}

/// The disk-side half of turning a preset toggle off for one tool: the
/// `skill_targets` record always goes, while whatever is at the recorded path
/// is only removed when it still matches what we deployed (#435).
fn unsync_skill_for_tool_in_preset(
    store: &SkillStore,
    skill_id: &str,
    tool: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let targets = store
        .get_targets_for_skill(skill_id)
        .map_err(AppError::db)?;
    if let Some(target) = targets.iter().find(|target| target.tool == tool) {
        // Same survivor check as `unsync_skill_from_tool`: another tool
        // sharing this skills directory keeps its deployment.
        let still_referenced = targets
            .iter()
            .any(|other| other.tool != tool && other.target_path == target.target_path);
        if still_referenced {
            return store.delete_target(skill_id, tool).map_err(AppError::db);
        }
        sync_engine::remove_recorded_target_or_warn(
            &PathBuf::from(&target.target_path),
            &target.mode,
        );
    }
    store.delete_target(skill_id, tool).map_err(AppError::db)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn sync_skill_to_tool(
    app: AppHandle,
    skill_id: String,
    tool: String,
    store: State<'_, Arc<SkillStore>>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let store = store.inner().clone();
    let result = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        let outcome = (|| -> Result<(), AppError> {
            sync_skill_to_tool_internal(&store, &skill_id, &tool)?;

            if let Ok(Some(active_id)) = store.get_active_scenario_id() {
                let skill_ids = store
                    .get_skill_ids_for_scenario(&active_id)
                    .map_err(AppError::db)?;
                if skill_ids.contains(&skill_id) {
                    let adapter_keys: Vec<String> =
                        tool_adapters::enabled_installed_adapters(&store)
                            .iter()
                            .map(|a| a.key.clone())
                            .collect();
                    store
                        .ensure_scenario_skill_tool_defaults(&active_id, &skill_id, &adapter_keys)
                        .map_err(AppError::db)?;
                    store
                        .set_scenario_skill_tool_enabled(&active_id, &skill_id, &tool, true)
                        .map_err(AppError::db)?;
                }
            }

            Ok(())
        })();
        log_sync_outcome(&store, "enable", &skill_id, &tool, outcome.as_ref());
        outcome
    })
    .await?;
    if result.is_ok() {
        schedule_tray_refresh(&app);
    }
    result
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn unsync_skill_from_tool(
    app: AppHandle,
    skill_id: String,
    tool: String,
    store: State<'_, Arc<SkillStore>>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let store = store.inner().clone();
    let result = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        let outcome = (|| -> Result<(), AppError> {
            let targets = store
                .get_targets_for_skill(&skill_id)
                .map_err(AppError::db)?;

            // Toggling a skill off is the GUI twin of `skills undeploy`, so it
            // needs the same protection: the row says we deployed here, but if
            // the user has since replaced our artifact with content of their
            // own, that content is not ours to delete (#363).
            if let Some(target) = targets.iter().find(|t| t.tool == tool) {
                let target_path = PathBuf::from(&target.target_path);
                // Several tools can resolve to one skills directory, so this
                // exact path may still be deployed for another (skill, tool)
                // that is staying. `apply_remove` has this survivor check;
                // without it here, switching agent A off deletes agent B's
                // live deployment.
                let still_referenced = store
                    .get_all_targets()
                    .map_err(AppError::db)?
                    .into_iter()
                    .any(|other| {
                        other.target_path == target.target_path
                            && !(other.skill_id == skill_id && other.tool == tool)
                    });
                if still_referenced {
                    log::debug!(
                        "unsync: keeping {} (still referenced by another target)",
                        target_path.display()
                    );
                } else {
                    match sync_engine::remove_recorded_target(&target_path, &target.mode) {
                        Ok(true) => {}
                        Ok(false) => log::warn!(
                            "unsync: preserving {} — no longer matches its recorded {} deployment; \
                             removing the record only",
                            target_path.display(),
                            target.mode
                        ),
                        Err(e) => {
                            log::warn!("unsync: failed to remove {}: {e}", target_path.display())
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            store
                .delete_target(&skill_id, &tool)
                .map_err(AppError::db)?;

            if let Ok(Some(active_id)) = store.get_active_scenario_id() {
                let skill_ids = store
                    .get_skill_ids_for_scenario(&active_id)
                    .map_err(AppError::db)?;
                if skill_ids.contains(&skill_id) {
                    let adapter_keys: Vec<String> =
                        tool_adapters::enabled_installed_adapters(&store)
                            .iter()
                            .map(|a| a.key.clone())
                            .collect();
                    store
                        .ensure_scenario_skill_tool_defaults(&active_id, &skill_id, &adapter_keys)
                        .map_err(AppError::db)?;
                    store
                        .set_scenario_skill_tool_enabled(&active_id, &skill_id, &tool, false)
                        .map_err(AppError::db)?;
                }
            }

            Ok(())
        })();
        log_sync_outcome(&store, "disable", &skill_id, &tool, outcome.as_ref());
        outcome
    })
    .await?;
    if result.is_ok() {
        schedule_tray_refresh(&app);
    }
    result
}

fn log_sync_outcome(
    store: &SkillStore,
    action: &str,
    skill_id: &str,
    tool: &str,
    outcome: Result<&(), &AppError>,
) {
    let name = store
        .get_skill_by_id(skill_id)
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .map(|s| s.name)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let mut draft = crate::core::audit_log::AuditDraft::new(action)
        .skill(skill_id.to_string(), name)
        .tool(tool.to_string());
    draft = match outcome {
        Ok(_) => draft.ok(),
        Err(e) => draft.fail(e.to_string()),
    };
    store.log_audit(draft);
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn get_skill_tool_toggles(
    skill_id: String,
    preset_id: String,
    store: State<'_, Arc<SkillStore>>,
) -> Result<Vec<SkillToolToggleDto>, AppError> {
    let store = store.inner().clone();
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        let skill_ids = store
            .get_skill_ids_for_scenario(&preset_id)
            .map_err(AppError::db)?;
        if !skill_ids.contains(&skill_id) {
            return Err(AppError::not_found("Skill is not enabled in this preset"));
        }

        let disabled = disabled_tools(&store);
        let all_adapters = tool_adapters::all_tool_adapters(&store);
        let default_enabled_keys: Vec<String> = all_adapters
            .iter()
            .filter(|adapter| adapter.is_installed() && !disabled.contains(&adapter.key))
            .map(|adapter| adapter.key.clone())
            .collect();
        store
            .ensure_scenario_skill_tool_defaults(&preset_id, &skill_id, &default_enabled_keys)
            .map_err(AppError::db)?;

        let toggles = store
            .get_scenario_skill_tool_toggles(&preset_id, &skill_id)
            .map_err(AppError::db)?;
        let enabled_map: std::collections::HashMap<String, bool> = toggles
            .into_iter()
            .map(|toggle| (toggle.tool, toggle.enabled))
            .collect();

        Ok(all_adapters
            .into_iter()
            .map(|adapter| {
                let globally_enabled = !disabled.contains(&adapter.key);
                let available = adapter.is_installed() && globally_enabled;
                SkillToolToggleDto {
                    // Unavailable tools are always presented as disabled in UI.
                    enabled: if available {
                        enabled_map.get(&adapter.key).copied().unwrap_or(false)
                    } else {
                        false
                    },
                    tool: adapter.key.clone(),
                    display_name: adapter.display_name.clone(),
                    installed: adapter.is_installed(),
                    globally_enabled,
                }
            })
            .collect())
    })
    .await?
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn set_skill_tool_toggle(
    app: AppHandle,
    skill_id: String,
    preset_id: String,
    tool: String,
    enabled: bool,
    store: State<'_, Arc<SkillStore>>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let store = store.inner().clone();
    let result = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        let skill_ids = store
            .get_skill_ids_for_scenario(&preset_id)
            .map_err(AppError::db)?;
        if !skill_ids.contains(&skill_id) {
            return Err(AppError::not_found("Skill is not enabled in this preset"));
        }

        let adapter = tool_adapters::find_adapter_with_store(&store, &tool)
            .ok_or_else(|| AppError::not_found(format!("Unknown tool: {}", tool)))?;
        let disabled = disabled_tools(&store);
        let globally_enabled = !disabled.contains(&tool);

        if enabled {
            if !adapter.is_installed() {
                return Err(AppError::not_found(format!(
                    "{} is not installed",
                    adapter.display_name
                )));
            }
            if !globally_enabled {
                return Err(AppError::invalid_input(format!(
                    "{} is disabled",
                    adapter.display_name
                )));
            }
        }

        sync_metadata::with_repo_lock("set skill tool toggle", || {
            store.set_scenario_skill_tool_enabled(&preset_id, &skill_id, &tool, enabled)?;
            sync_metadata::write_all_from_db_unlocked(&store)
        })
        .map_err(AppError::db)?;

        let is_active = store
            .get_active_scenario_id()
            .map_err(AppError::db)?
            .as_deref()
            == Some(preset_id.as_str());
        if is_active {
            if enabled {
                sync_skill_to_tool_internal(&store, &skill_id, &tool)?;
            } else {
                unsync_skill_for_tool_in_preset(&store, &skill_id, &tool)?;
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    })
    .await?;
    if result.is_ok() {
        schedule_tray_refresh(&app);
    }
    result
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::core::skill_store::SkillRecord;
    use crate::core::tool_adapters::CustomToolDef;
    use std::fs;
    use tempfile::tempdir;

    fn sample_skill(id: &str, name: &str, central_path: &std::path::Path) -> SkillRecord {
        SkillRecord {
            id: id.to_string(),
            name: name.to_string(),
            description: None,
            source_type: "import".to_string(),
            source_ref: Some(central_path.to_string_lossy().to_string()),
            source_ref_resolved: None,
            source_subpath: None,
            source_branch: None,
            source_revision: None,
            remote_revision: None,
            central_path: central_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
            content_hash: None,
            enabled: true,
            created_at: 1,
            updated_at: 1,
            status: "ok".to_string(),
            update_status: "local_only".to_string(),
            last_checked_at: None,
            last_check_error: None,
        }
    }

    fn write_skill_dir(base: &std::path::Path, dir_name: &str, marker: &str) -> PathBuf {
        let dir = base.join(dir_name);
        fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        fs::write(
            dir.join("SKILL.md"),
            format!("---\nname: {dir_name}\n---\n"),
        )
        .unwrap();
        fs::write(dir.join("unique.txt"), marker).unwrap();
        dir
    }

    fn configure_single_custom_tool(store: &SkillStore, target_base: &std::path::Path) {
        let custom_tools = vec![CustomToolDef {
            key: "test_agent".to_string(),
            display_name: "Test Agent".to_string(),
            skills_dir: target_base.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
            project_relative_skills_dir: None,
            category: Default::default(),
        }];
        store
            .set_setting(
                "custom_tools",
                &serde_json::to_string(&custom_tools).unwrap(),
            )
            .unwrap();
        let disabled_builtin_tools: Vec<String> = tool_adapters::default_tool_adapters()
            .into_iter()
            .map(|adapter| adapter.key)
            .collect();
        store
            .set_setting(
                "disabled_tools",
                &serde_json::to_string(&disabled_builtin_tools).unwrap(),
            )
            .unwrap();
        store.set_setting("sync_mode", "copy").unwrap();
    }

    /// Two agents resolving to one skills directory, which is what makes a
    /// single filesystem object be claimed by several `skill_targets` rows
    /// (the table is unique on `(skill_id, tool)`, not on `target_path`).
    fn configure_two_custom_tools_sharing_a_dir(store: &SkillStore, shared: &std::path::Path) {
        let custom_tools: Vec<CustomToolDef> = ["agent_a", "agent_b"]
            .into_iter()
            .map(|key| CustomToolDef {
                key: key.to_string(),
                display_name: key.to_string(),
                skills_dir: shared.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
                project_relative_skills_dir: None,
                category: Default::default(),
            })
            .collect();
        store
            .set_setting(
                "custom_tools",
                &serde_json::to_string(&custom_tools).unwrap(),
            )
            .unwrap();
        let disabled_builtin_tools: Vec<String> = tool_adapters::default_tool_adapters()
            .into_iter()
            .map(|adapter| adapter.key)
            .collect();
        store
            .set_setting(
                "disabled_tools",
                &serde_json::to_string(&disabled_builtin_tools).unwrap(),
            )
            .unwrap();
        store.set_setting("sync_mode", "copy").unwrap();
    }

    /// Deploying to two agents that share a skills directory must succeed. The
    /// second pair has no row of its own when the batch starts, so without
    /// batch-level evidence it would refuse the directory the first pair just
    /// wrote (#363 review, round 2).
    #[test]
    fn shared_skills_dir_deploys_to_both_agents_in_one_batch() {
        let tmp = tempdir().unwrap();
        let store = SkillStore::new(&tmp.path().join("test.db")).unwrap();
        let source_base = tmp.path().join("central");
        let shared = tmp.path().join("shared-agent-skills");
        fs::create_dir_all(&source_base).unwrap();
        fs::create_dir_all(&shared).unwrap();
        configure_two_custom_tools_sharing_a_dir(&store, &shared);

        let dir = write_skill_dir(&source_base, "shared-skill", "content");
        store
            .insert_skill(&sample_skill("s1", "shared-skill", &dir))
            .unwrap();

        scenario_service::apply_skills_to_tools(
            &store,
            &["s1".to_string()],
            &["agent_a".to_string(), "agent_b".to_string()],
            scenario_service::BatchApplyMode::Add,
        )
        .expect("a shared target directory must not make the second agent refuse");

        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(shared.join("shared-skill/unique.txt")).unwrap(),
            "content"
        );
        let rows = store.get_targets_for_skill("s1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(rows.len(), 2, "both agents should be recorded: {rows:?}");
    }

    /// Contradictory rows for one path are ambiguous evidence, and a fix whose
    /// purpose is preservation must refuse rather than guess. Regression for the
    /// hole that survived three review rounds: evidence has to be pooled from
    /// every row on the path, including rows this batch did not select.
    #[test]
    fn contradictory_rows_on_a_shared_path_refuse_to_replace_user_content() {
        let tmp = tempdir().unwrap();
        let store = SkillStore::new(&tmp.path().join("test.db")).unwrap();
        let source_base = tmp.path().join("central");
        let shared = tmp.path().join("shared-agent-skills");
        fs::create_dir_all(&source_base).unwrap();
        fs::create_dir_all(&shared).unwrap();
        configure_two_custom_tools_sharing_a_dir(&store, &shared);

        let dir = write_skill_dir(&source_base, "shared-skill", "content");
        store
            .insert_skill(&sample_skill("s1", "shared-skill", &dir))
            .unwrap();

        // A real directory of the user's now sits at the shared target.
        let target = shared.join("shared-skill");
        fs::create_dir_all(&target).unwrap();
        fs::write(target.join("mine.txt"), "DO_NOT_OVERWRITE").unwrap();

        // Two rows disagree about what we put there. Only agent_a is selected
        // below, so the contradicting agent_b row is exactly the "unselected
        // row" that pooling from the batch alone would have missed.
        for (tool, mode) in [("agent_a", "copy"), ("agent_b", "symlink")] {
            store
                .insert_target(&crate::core::skill_store::SkillTargetRecord {
                    id: format!("t-{tool}"),
                    skill_id: "s1".to_string(),
                    tool: tool.to_string(),
                    target_path: target.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
                    mode: mode.to_string(),
                    status: "ok".to_string(),
                    synced_at: Some(1),
                    last_error: None,
                    source_hash: Some("h1".to_string()),
                })
                .unwrap();
        }

        let result = scenario_service::apply_skills_to_tools(
            &store,
            &["s1".to_string()],
            &["agent_a".to_string()],
            scenario_service::BatchApplyMode::Add,
        );

        assert!(
            result.is_err(),
            "contradictory records must refuse, not guess a mode"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(target.join("mine.txt")).unwrap(),
            "DO_NOT_OVERWRITE"
        );
    }

    /// #435: unchecking a skill for one tool in the active preset used to
    /// delete whatever sat at the recorded path. A real directory that
    /// replaced our symlink is the user's — preserve it and drop only the
    /// record.
    #[test]
    fn preset_unsync_preserves_user_content_that_replaced_a_recorded_link() {
        let tmp = tempdir().unwrap();
        let store = SkillStore::new(&tmp.path().join("test.db")).unwrap();
        let target = tmp.path().join("agent-skills").join("my-skill");
        fs::create_dir_all(&target).unwrap();
        fs::write(target.join("mine.txt"), "DO_NOT_OVERWRITE").unwrap();
        store
            .insert_skill(&sample_skill("s1", "my-skill", &tmp.path().join("central")))
            .unwrap();
        store
            .insert_target(&crate::core::skill_store::SkillTargetRecord {
                id: "t1".to_string(),
                skill_id: "s1".to_string(),
                tool: "agent_a".to_string(),
                target_path: target.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
                mode: "symlink".to_string(),
                status: "ok".to_string(),
                synced_at: Some(1),
                last_error: None,
                source_hash: None,
            })
            .unwrap();

        unsync_skill_for_tool_in_preset(&store, "s1", "agent_a").unwrap();

        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(target.join("mine.txt")).unwrap(),
            "DO_NOT_OVERWRITE",
            "the user's directory must survive the uncheck"
        );
        assert!(store.get_targets_for_skill("s1").unwrap().is_empty());
    }

    /// Unchecking one tool must not delete a deployment another tool shares.
    #[test]
    fn preset_unsync_keeps_a_deployment_another_tool_shares() {
        let tmp = tempdir().unwrap();
        let store = SkillStore::new(&tmp.path().join("test.db")).unwrap();
        let target = tmp.path().join("agent-skills").join("my-skill");
        fs::create_dir_all(&target).unwrap();
        fs::write(target.join("SKILL.md"), "---\nname: my-skill\n---\n").unwrap();
        store
            .insert_skill(&sample_skill("s1", "my-skill", &tmp.path().join("central")))
            .unwrap();
        for (id, tool) in [("t1", "agent_a"), ("t2", "agent_b")] {
            store
                .insert_target(&crate::core::skill_store::SkillTargetRecord {
                    id: id.to_string(),
                    skill_id: "s1".to_string(),
                    tool: tool.to_string(),
                    target_path: target.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
                    mode: "copy".to_string(),
                    status: "ok".to_string(),
                    synced_at: Some(1),
                    last_error: None,
                    source_hash: None,
                })
                .unwrap();
        }

        unsync_skill_for_tool_in_preset(&store, "s1", "agent_a").unwrap();

        assert!(target.exists(), "agent_b still deploys this path");
        let remaining = store.get_targets_for_skill("s1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(remaining.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(remaining[0].tool, "agent_b");
    }

    #[test]
    fn sync_skill_to_tool_keeps_duplicate_skill_names_separate() {
        let tmp = tempdir().unwrap();
        let store = SkillStore::new(&tmp.path().join("test.db")).unwrap();
        let source_base = tmp.path().join("central");
        let target_base = tmp.path().join("agent-skills");
        fs::create_dir_all(&source_base).unwrap();
        fs::create_dir_all(&target_base).unwrap();
        configure_single_custom_tool(&store, &target_base);

        let first_dir = write_skill_dir(&source_base, "skill123", "first");
        let second_dir = write_skill_dir(&source_base, "skill123-2", "second");
        store
            .insert_skill(&sample_skill("first", "skill123", &first_dir))
            .unwrap();
        store
            .insert_skill(&sample_skill("second", "skill123", &second_dir))
            .unwrap();

        sync_skill_to_tool_internal(&store, "first", "test_agent").unwrap();
        sync_skill_to_tool_internal(&store, "second", "test_agent").unwrap();

        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(target_base.join("skill123/unique.txt")).unwrap(),
            "first"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(target_base.join("skill123-2/unique.txt")).unwrap(),
            "second"
        );
    }
}

use super::{
    package_store::{reject_links, validate_slug},
    types::*,
};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

pub fn path_key(path: &Path) -> String {
    let key = path
        .to_string_lossy()
        .replace('\\', "/")
        .trim_end_matches('/')
        .to_lowercase();
    if let Some(unc) = key.strip_prefix("//?/unc/") {
        format!("//{unc}")
    } else {
        key.strip_prefix("//?/").unwrap_or(&key).to_string()
    }
}
pub fn overlaps(a: &Path, b: &Path) -> bool {
    let a = path_key(a);
    let b = path_key(b);
    a == b || a.starts_with(&(b.clone() + "/")) || b.starts_with(&(a + "/"))
}
pub fn validate_ancestors(path: &Path) -> CompanyResult<()> {
    for ancestor in path.ancestors() {
        match std::fs::symlink_metadata(ancestor) {
            Ok(_) => reject_links(ancestor)?,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
            Err(_) => {
                return Err(CompanyError::new(
                    "PATH_ERROR",
                    "Không kiểm tra được đường dẫn. Kiểm tra quyền thư mục.",
                ))
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn global_target(profile: &Path, slug: &str) -> CompanyResult<PathBuf> {
    validate_slug(slug)?;
    let target = profile.join(".aipro").join("skills").join(slug);
    validate_ancestors(&target)?;
    Ok(target)
}
pub fn stage_path(target: &Path, id: &str) -> CompanyResult<PathBuf> {
    uuid::Uuid::parse_str(id)
        .map_err(|_| CompanyError::new("WRITE_FAILED", "Operation ID không hợp lệ."))?;
    Ok(target
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| CompanyError::new("WRITE_FAILED", "Đích cài không hợp lệ."))?
        .join(format!(".company-stage-{id}")))
}

use super::types::{CompanyError, CompanyResult};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::{
    env, fs,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CompanyConfig {
    pub store_url: String,
    pub profile_root: PathBuf,
    pub data_root: PathBuf,
    pub mock: bool,
    pub allowed_hosts: Vec<String>,
}
#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct Environment {
    pub store_url: String,
    pub profile_root: String,
    pub data_root: String,
    pub mock: bool,
    pub configured: bool,
    pub recovery_warnings: Vec<String>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct StoreConfig {
    base_url: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    allowed_hosts: Vec<String>,
}

impl CompanyConfig {
    pub fn from_environment() -> CompanyResult<Self> {
        Self::from_environment_with_resource(None)
    }
    pub fn from_environment_with_resource(resource: Option<&Path>) -> CompanyResult<Self> {
        let default_profile = dirs::home_dir().ok_or_else(|| {
            CompanyError::new(
                "CONFIGURATION_ERROR",
                "Không xác định được profile Windows.",
            )
        })?;
        let default_data = dirs::data_local_dir()
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                CompanyError::new(
                    "CONFIGURATION_ERROR",
                    "Không xác định được thư mục dữ liệu.",
                )
            })?
            .join("CompanySkillsManager");
        let overrides = [
            "COMPANY_STORE_MODE",
            "COMPANY_STORE_BASE_URL",
            "COMPANY_PROFILE_ROOT",
            "COMPANY_DATA_ROOT",
        ];
        if !cfg!(debug_assertions) && overrides.iter().any(|name| env::var(name).is_ok()) {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "CONFIGURATION_ERROR",
                "Bản phát hành không nhận cấu hình debug/mock.",
            ));
        }
        let data_root = env::var_os("COMPANY_DATA_ROOT")
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or(default_data);
        let profile_root = env::var_os("COMPANY_PROFILE_ROOT")
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or(default_profile);
        let file = data_root.join("store.json");
        let (store_url, allowed_hosts) = match env::var("COMPANY_STORE_BASE_URL") {
            Ok(url) => (url, vec![]),
            Err(_) if file.exists() || resource.is_some_and(|p| p.is_file()) => {
                let file = if file.exists() {
                    file.as_path()
                } else {
                    resource.unwrap()
                };
                let stored =
                    serde_json::from_slice::<StoreConfig>(&fs::read(file).map_err(|_| {
                        CompanyError::new("CONFIGURATION_ERROR", "Không đọc được store.json.")
                    })?)
                    .map_err(|_| {
                        CompanyError::new("CONFIGURATION_ERROR", "store.json không hợp lệ.")
                    })?;
                (stored.base_url, stored.allowed_hosts)
            }
            Err(_) => (String::new(), vec![]),
        };
        let config = Self {
            store_url: store_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
            profile_root,
            data_root,
            mock: env::var("COMPANY_STORE_MODE").as_deref() == Ok("mock"),
            allowed_hosts,
        };
        config.validate()?;
        Ok(config)
    }
    pub fn for_test(url: &str, profile_root: PathBuf, data_root: PathBuf) -> CompanyResult<Self> {
        let config = Self {
            store_url: url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
            profile_root,
            data_root,
            mock: true,
            allowed_hosts: vec![],
        };
        config.validate()?;
        Ok(config)
    }
    pub fn validate(&self) -> CompanyResult<()> {
        if !self.profile_root.is_absolute() || !self.data_root.is_absolute() {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "CONFIGURATION_ERROR",
                "Đường dẫn profile và dữ liệu phải là đường dẫn tuyệt đối.",
            ));
        }
        if self.mock && !cfg!(debug_assertions) {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "CONFIGURATION_ERROR",
                "Bản phát hành không nhận mock.",
            ));
        }
        validate_store_endpoint(
            &self.store_url,
            &self.allowed_hosts,
            cfg!(debug_assertions) && self.mock,
        )
    }
    pub fn environment(&self) -> Environment {
        Environment {
            store_url: self.store_url.clone(),
            profile_root: self.profile_root.display().to_string(),
            data_root: self.data_root.display().to_string(),
            mock: self.mock,
            configured: !self.store_url.is_empty(),
            recovery_warnings: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

pub fn validate_store_endpoint(
    base_url: &str,
    allowed_hosts: &[String],
    allow_debug_mock: bool,
) -> CompanyResult<()> {
    if base_url.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let url = reqwest::Url::parse(base_url)
        .map_err(|_| CompanyError::new("CONFIGURATION_ERROR", "Địa chỉ Store không hợp lệ."))?;
    let host = url.host_str().unwrap_or_default();
    let loopback = matches!(host, "127.0.0.1" | "localhost" | "::1" | "[::1]");
    let mock = allow_debug_mock && loopback;
    if (url.scheme() != "https" && !(mock && url.scheme() == "http"))
        || (!mock
            && (loopback
                || !allowed_hosts
                    .iter()
                    .any(|allowed| allowed.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(host))))
        || !url.username().is_empty()
        || url.password().is_some()
        || url.query().is_some()
        || url.fragment().is_some()
        || url.path() != "/"
        || host.ends_with(".example")
        || host.ends_with(".invalid")
        || matches!(host, "example.com" | "example.org" | "example.net")
    {
        return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "CONFIGURATION_ERROR",
                "Store phải dùng HTTPS và host được IT cho phép. HTTP loopback chỉ dùng cho mock debug.",
            ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

use super::*;
use crate::core::company::aipro_paths::{overlaps, path_key, validate_ancestors};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn conflict() -> CompanyError {
    CompanyError::new(
        "TARGET_CONFLICT",
        "Đích đã có bản cài hoặc nội dung khác. Không ghi đè.",
    )
}
fn changed() -> CompanyError {
    CompanyError::new(
        "CONTENT_CHANGED",
        "Nội dung đã thay đổi sau khi xem. Chuẩn bị thao tác lại.",
    )
}
fn recovery_error() -> CompanyError {
    CompanyError::new(
        "RECOVERY_REQUIRED",
        "Đã giữ dữ liệu khôi phục/gỡ cần kiểm tra. Mở lại app để phục hồi.",
    )
}
fn absent(path: &Path) -> bool {
    fs::symlink_metadata(path).is_err_and(|e| e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound)
}
fn matches(path: &Path, hash: &str) -> bool {
    path.is_dir()
        && validate_ancestors(path).is_ok()
        && content_hash(path, false).ok().as_deref() == Some(hash)
}
fn snapshot_skill(item: &Installation) -> Skill {
    Skill {
        id: item.skill_id.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
        slug: item.slug.clone(),
        name: item.name.clone(),
        description_excerpt: None,
        description: Some(item.description_snapshot.clone()),
        updated_at: item.installed_at.clone(),
        package: PackageMeta {
            format: "zip".into(),
            size_bytes: 0,
            sha256: item.package_hash.clone(),
            etag: String::new(),
        },
    }
}

impl CompanyService {
    pub(super) fn verify_backup(&self, backup: &Backup) -> CompanyResult<PathBuf> {
        let invalid = || {
            CompanyError::new(
                "BACKUP_INVALID",
                "Bản lưu thiếu, đã thay đổi hoặc không hợp lệ. Giữ bản đang dùng.",
            )
        };
        uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&backup.id).map_err(|_| invalid())?;
        uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&backup.installation_id).map_err(|_| invalid())?;
        if backup.installation_id != backup.installation.id {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
        let content = self
            .config
            .data_root
            .join("backups")
            .join(&backup.installation_id)
            .join(&backup.id)
            .join("content");
        if path_key(&content) != path_key(Path::new(&backup.path))
            || !matches(&content, &backup.full_hash)
        {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
        let metadata: Backup = serde_json::from_slice(
            &fs::read(content.parent().unwrap().join("metadata.json")).map_err(|_| invalid())?,
        )
        .map_err(|_| invalid())?;
        if serde_json::to_value(metadata).ok() != serde_json::to_value(backup).ok() {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
        Ok(content)
    }
    pub fn prepare_restore(&self, backup_id: &str) -> CompanyResult<OperationView> {
        let _worker = self.worker.lock().map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        let backup = self
            .repository
            .all_backups()?
            .into_iter()
            .find(|b| b.id == backup_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| CompanyError::new("BACKUP_NOT_FOUND", "Không tìm thấy bản lưu."))?;
        self.verify_backup(&backup)?;
        let old = self.guarded_installation(&backup.installation_id)?;
        if old.target != backup.installation.target
            || old.slug != backup.installation.slug
            || old.project_id != backup.installation.project_id
        {
            return Err(conflict());
        }
        let mut new = backup.installation.clone();
        new.state = InstallationState::Active;
        new.store_state = if new.origin == Origin::Local {
            StoreState::NotApplicable
        } else {
            StoreState::Unknown
        };
        new.checked_at = None;
        new.store_error = None;
        self.prepare_lifecycle(old, new, Some(backup), OperationKind::Restore)
    }
    pub fn prepare_remove(&self, installation_id: &str) -> CompanyResult<OperationView> {
        let _worker = self.worker.lock().map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        let old = self.guarded_installation(installation_id)?;
        if old.state != InstallationState::Active {
            return Err(CompanyError::new("ALREADY_REMOVED", "Bản cài đã gỡ."));
        }
        let mut new = old.clone();
        new.state = InstallationState::Removed;
        new.content_state = ContentState::Missing;
        self.prepare_lifecycle(old, new, None, OperationKind::Remove)
    }
    fn check_lifecycle_target(&self, old: &Installation) -> CompanyResult<PathBuf> {
        let target = self.installation_target(old.project_id.as_deref(), &old.slug)?;
        if path_key(&target) != path_key(Path::new(&old.target)) {
            return Err(conflict());
        }
        if self.repository.installations()?.iter().any(|i| {
            i.state == InstallationState::Active
                && i.id != old.id
                && overlaps(Path::new(&i.target), &target)
        }) {
            return Err(conflict());
        }
        if old.state == InstallationState::Removed && !absent(&target) {
            return Err(conflict());
        }
        Ok(target)
    }
    fn prepare_lifecycle(
        &self,
        old: Installation,
        new: Installation,
        source: Option<Backup>,
        kind: OperationKind,
    ) -> CompanyResult<OperationView> {
        let target = self.check_lifecycle_target(&old)?;
        if self
            .operations
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .values()
            .any(|op| {
                !matches!(
                    op.view.state,
                    OperationState::Succeeded | OperationState::Failed | OperationState::Cancelled
                ) && overlaps(Path::new(&op.view.target), &target)
            })
        {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "TARGET_BUSY",
                "Đích có thao tác chưa hoàn tất. Đóng hoặc hủy thao tác đó trước.",
            ));
        }
        let old_hash = if absent(&target) {
            None
        } else {
            Some(content_hash(&target, false)?)
        };
        let view = OperationView {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            state: OperationState::AwaitingDecision,
            target: old.target.clone(),
            mcp: McpReport {
                state: McpState::Undeclared,
                required: vec![],
                present: vec![],
                missing: vec![],
                reason: Some("Snapshot cục bộ; không kiểm tra lại MCP/Store.".into()),
                checked_at: String::new(),
            },
            mcp_path: String::new(),
            skill: None,
            progress_bytes: 0,
            total_bytes: 0,
            error: None,
            kind,
            preview_ready: true,
            customized: self.refreshed(old.clone()).content_state == ContentState::Customized,
            changes: vec![],
        };
        let journal = LifecycleJournal {
            view: view.clone(),
            old: old.clone(),
            new,
            old_full_hash: old_hash,
            new_full_hash: source.as_ref().map(|b| b.full_hash.clone()),
            current_backup: None,
            source_backup: source,
            phase: ReplacePhase::Prepared,
            stage_owned: false,
        };
        self.operations
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .insert(
                view.id.clone(),
                Operation {
                    view: view.clone(),
                    skill: snapshot_skill(&old),
                    owner: String::new(),
                    cancelled: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
                    project_id: old.project_id.clone(),
                    old: Some(old),
                    old_full_hash: journal.old_full_hash.clone(),
                    preview: None,
                    bypass: false,
                },
            );
        self.lifecycle_jobs
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .insert(view.id.clone(), journal);
        Ok(view)
    }
    pub fn apply_lifecycle(self: &Arc<Self>, id: &str) -> CompanyResult<OperationView> {
        let journal = self
            .lifecycle_jobs
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .get(id)
            .cloned()
            .ok_or_else(operation_error)?;
        let (cancelled, view) = {
            let mut ops = self.operations.lock().map_err(|_| operation_error())?;
            let op = ops.get_mut(id).ok_or_else(operation_error)?;
            Self::check_cancel(&op.cancelled)?;
            if op.view.state != OperationState::AwaitingDecision {
                return Ok(op.view.clone());
            }
            op.view.state = OperationState::Staging;
            (op.cancelled.clone(), op.view.clone())
        };
        let app = self.clone();
        let id = id.to_string();
        std::thread::spawn(move || match app.run_lifecycle(journal, &cancelled) {
            Ok(()) => app.update(&id, OperationState::Succeeded, None, None),
            Err(error) => {
                let state = match error.code.as_str() {
                    "CANCELLED" => OperationState::Cancelled,
                    "RECOVERY_REQUIRED" => OperationState::RecoveryRequired,
                    _ => OperationState::Failed,
                };
                app.update(&id, state, None, Some(error));
            }
        });
        Ok(view)
    }
    fn lifecycle_paths(&self, j: &LifecycleJournal) -> CompanyResult<(PathBuf, PathBuf, PathBuf)> {
        if j.old.id != j.new.id
            || j.old.target != j.new.target
            || j.old.project_id != j.new.project_id
            || j.old.slug != j.new.slug
        {
            return Err(recovery_error());
        }
        let target = self.installation_target(j.old.project_id.as_deref(), &j.old.slug)?;
        if path_key(&target) != path_key(Path::new(&j.old.target)) {
            return Err(recovery_error());
        }
        let stage = stage_path(&target, &j.view.id)?;
        let rollback = target
            .parent()
            .ok_or_else(write_error)?
            .join(format!(".company-rollback-{}", j.view.id));
        validate_ancestors(&rollback)?;
        Ok((target, stage, rollback))
    }
    fn run_lifecycle(&self, mut j: LifecycleJournal, cancelled: &AtomicBool) -> CompanyResult<()> {
        let _worker = self.worker.lock().map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        Self::check_cancel(cancelled)?;
        let current = self.guarded_installation(&j.old.id)?;
        if current.package_hash != j.old.package_hash
            || current.state != j.old.state
            || current.content_hash != j.old.content_hash
        {
            return Err(changed());
        }
        let target = self.check_lifecycle_target(&j.old)?;
        let expected_old = j.old_full_hash.clone();
        let old_matches = |path: &Path| match &expected_old {
            Some(hash) => matches(path, hash),
            None => absent(path),
        };
        if !old_matches(&target) {
            return Err(changed());
        }
        let source = j
            .source_backup
            .as_ref()
            .map(|b| self.verify_backup(b))
            .transpose()?;
        if let Some(hash) = &j.old_full_hash {
            j.current_backup = Some(self.snapshot_backup(
                &current,
                hash,
                if j.view.kind == OperationKind::Remove {
                    "remove"
                } else {
                    "restore"
                },
            )?);
        }
        let (target, stage, rollback) = self.lifecycle_paths(&j)?;
        if !absent(&stage) || !absent(&rollback) {
            return Err(conflict());
        }
        validate_ancestors(target.parent().ok_or_else(write_error)?)?;
        fs::create_dir_all(target.parent().ok_or_else(write_error)?).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        self.repository.record_lifecycle(&j)?;
        let mut moved = false;
        let result = (|| {
            if let Some(source) = &source {
                fs::create_dir(&stage).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
                j.stage_owned = true;
                self.repository.record_lifecycle(&j)?;
                copy_tree(source, &stage)?;
                if !matches(
                    &stage,
                    j.new_full_hash.as_deref().ok_or_else(recovery_error)?,
                ) {
                    return Err(write_error());
                }
                self.verify_backup(j.source_backup.as_ref().unwrap())?;
            }
            Self::check_cancel(cancelled)?;
            self.check_lifecycle_target(&j.old)?;
            if !old_matches(&target) {
                return Err(changed());
            }
            self.enter_commit(&j.view.id)?;
            if j.old_full_hash.is_some() {
                fs::rename(&target, &rollback).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
                moved = true;
                j.phase = ReplacePhase::OldMoved;
                self.repository.record_lifecycle(&j)?;
                if !matches(&rollback, j.old_full_hash.as_deref().unwrap()) {
                    if absent(&target) && rollback.is_dir() && validate_ancestors(&rollback).is_ok()
                    {
                        fs::rename(&rollback, &target).map_err(|_| recovery_error())?;
                        moved = false;
                    }
                    return Err(changed());
                }
            }
            if !absent(&target) {
                return Err(conflict());
            }
            if j.new_full_hash.is_some() {
                if !matches(&stage, j.new_full_hash.as_deref().unwrap()) {
                    return Err(recovery_error());
                }
                fs::rename(&stage, &target).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
                moved = true;
                if !matches(&target, j.new_full_hash.as_deref().unwrap()) {
                    return Err(recovery_error());
                }
            }
            j.phase = ReplacePhase::NewMoved;
            self.repository.record_lifecycle(&j)?;
            j.phase = ReplacePhase::Committed;
            self.repository.commit_lifecycle(&j)?;
            Ok(())
        })();
        if let Err(error) = result {
            if !moved {
                if j.stage_owned && !absent(&stage) {
                    if !j
                        .new_full_hash
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_some_and(|hash| matches(&stage, hash))
                    {
                        return Err(recovery_error());
                    }
                    cleanup::remove_verified_tree(
                        &stage,
                        j.new_full_hash.as_deref().ok_or_else(recovery_error)?,
                    )
                    .map_err(|_| recovery_error())?;
                }
                self.repository.finish_lifecycle(&j.view.id)?;
                return Err(error);
            }
            let durable = self
                .repository
                .pending_lifecycle()?
                .into_iter()
                .find(|p| p.view.id == j.view.id)
                .ok_or_else(recovery_error)?;
            if !self.recover_lifecycle_one(&durable).unwrap_or(false) {
                return Err(recovery_error());
            }
            return Err(error);
        }
        if !self.recover_lifecycle_one(&j).unwrap_or(false) {
            return Err(recovery_error());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    pub(super) fn recover_lifecycle_one(&self, j: &LifecycleJournal) -> CompanyResult<bool> {
        let (target, stage, rollback) = self.lifecycle_paths(j)?;
        if self.repository.installations()?.iter().any(|item| {
            item.id != j.old.id
                && item.state == InstallationState::Active
                && overlaps(Path::new(&item.target), &target)
        }) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if let Some(backup) = &j.current_backup {
            if self.verify_backup(backup).is_err()
                || Some(backup.full_hash.as_str()) != j.old_full_hash.as_deref()
            {
                return Ok(false);
            }
        } else if j.old_full_hash.is_some() {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if !absent(&stage)
            && (!j.stage_owned || !j.new_full_hash.as_ref().is_some_and(|h| matches(&stage, h)))
        {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if !absent(&rollback)
            && !j
                .old_full_hash
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|h| matches(&rollback, h))
        {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        let current = self.guarded_installation(&j.old.id)?;
        if j.phase == ReplacePhase::Committed {
            if serde_json::to_value(&current).ok() != serde_json::to_value(&j.new).ok() {
                return Ok(false);
            }
            if !absent(&stage) {
                cleanup::remove_verified_tree(
                    &stage,
                    j.new_full_hash.as_deref().ok_or_else(recovery_error)?,
                )?;
            }
            if !absent(&rollback) {
                cleanup::remove_verified_tree(
                    &rollback,
                    j.old_full_hash.as_deref().ok_or_else(recovery_error)?,
                )?;
            }
        } else {
            if serde_json::to_value(&current).ok() != serde_json::to_value(&j.old).ok() {
                return Ok(false);
            }
            if !absent(&rollback) || j.old_full_hash.is_none() {
                if !absent(&target) {
                    if !absent(&stage)
                        || !j.stage_owned
                        || !j
                            .new_full_hash
                            .as_ref()
                            .is_some_and(|h| matches(&target, h))
                    {
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    fs::rename(&target, &stage).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
                }
                if !absent(&rollback) {
                    fs::rename(&rollback, &target).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
                }
            } else if !j
                .old_full_hash
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|h| matches(&target, h))
            {
                return Ok(false);
            }
            if !absent(&stage) {
                cleanup::remove_verified_tree(
                    &stage,
                    j.new_full_hash.as_deref().ok_or_else(recovery_error)?,
                )?;
            }
        }
        self.repository.finish_lifecycle(&j.view.id)?;
        Ok(true)
    }
    pub(super) fn recover_lifecycle(&self) -> CompanyResult<()> {
        for journal in self.repository.pending_lifecycle()? {
            if self.recover_lifecycle_one(&journal).unwrap_or(false) {
                continue;
            }
            let mut view = journal.view.clone();
            view.state = OperationState::RecoveryRequired;
            view.error = Some(CompanyError::new(
                "RECOVERY_REQUIRED",
                format!(
                    "Đã giữ dữ liệu khôi phục/gỡ tại {} và .company-rollback-{}.",
                    view.target, view.id
                ),
            ));
            self.operations
                .lock()
                .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
                .insert(
                    view.id.clone(),
                    Operation {
                        view,
                        skill: snapshot_skill(&journal.old),
                        owner: String::new(),
                        cancelled: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(true)),
                        project_id: journal.old.project_id.clone(),
                        old: Some(journal.old),
                        old_full_hash: journal.old_full_hash,
                        preview: None,
                        bypass: false,
                    },
                );
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

use super::*;
use crate::core::company::aipro_paths::{overlaps, validate_ancestors};
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct LocalSource {
    path: PathBuf,
    meta: PackageMeta,
}

impl CompanyService {
    pub fn prepare_local_import(
        &self,
        archive: &Path,
        slug: &str,
        project_id: Option<&str>,
    ) -> CompanyResult<OperationView> {
        let _worker = self.worker.lock().map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        package_store::validate_slug(slug)?;
        validate_ancestors(archive)?;
        if !archive.is_absolute() || !archive.is_file() {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "INVALID_PACKAGE",
                "Chọn file ZIP hoặc 7z có sẵn trên máy.",
            ));
        }
        let format = archive
            .extension()
            .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .to_ascii_lowercase();
        if !matches!(format.as_str(), "zip" | "7z") {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "INVALID_PACKAGE",
                "Chỉ hỗ trợ ZIP hoặc 7z.",
            ));
        }
        let target = self.installation_target(project_id, slug)?;
        if fs::symlink_metadata(&target).is_ok()
            || self.repository.installations()?.iter().any(|i| {
                i.state == InstallationState::Active && overlaps(Path::new(&i.target), &target)
            })
        {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "TARGET_CONFLICT",
                "Đích đã có bản cài hoặc nội dung được quản lý. Không ghi đè.",
            ));
        }
        if self
            .operations
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .values()
            .any(|op| {
                op.view.state == OperationState::RecoveryRequired
                    && overlaps(Path::new(&op.view.target), &target)
            })
        {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "RECOVERY_REQUIRED",
                "Đích có dữ liệu chưa phục hồi. Không nhập đè.",
            ));
        }
        let mut input = File::open(archive).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        let mut buffer = [0u8; 65_536];
        let mut hash = Sha256::new();
        let mut size = 0u64;
        loop {
            let count = input.read(&mut buffer).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
            if count == 0 {
                break;
            }
            size += count as u64;
            if size > MAX_ARCHIVE {
                return Err(CompanyError::new(
                    "INVALID_PACKAGE",
                    "File vượt giới hạn 100 MiB.",
                ));
            }
            hash.update(&buffer[..count]);
        }
        if size == 0 {
            return Err(CompanyError::new("INVALID_PACKAGE", "File gói rỗng."));
        }
        let meta = PackageMeta {
            format,
            size_bytes: size,
            sha256: hex::encode(hash.finalize()),
            etag: String::new(),
        };
        // OperationView uses the shared name/package shape. An empty operation
        // skill id never becomes a Store association on a local installation.
        let skill = Skill {
            id: String::new(),
            slug: slug.into(),
            name: slug.into(),
            description_excerpt: None,
            description: None,
            updated_at: String::new(),
            package: meta.clone(),
        };
        let view = OperationView { id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(), state: OperationState::AwaitingDecision,
            target: target.display().to_string(), mcp: McpReport { state: McpState::Unknown, required: vec![], present: vec![], missing: vec![],
                reason: Some("Gói local chưa có dữ liệu yêu cầu MCP từ Skill Store. Không suy ra yêu cầu từ SKILL.md.".into()), checked_at: String::new() },
            mcp_path: String::new(), skill: Some(skill.clone()), progress_bytes: 0, total_bytes: size, error: None,
            kind: OperationKind::LocalImport, preview_ready: false, customized: false, changes: vec![] };
        self.local_sources
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .insert(
                view.id.clone(),
                LocalSource {
                    path: archive.into(),
                    meta,
                },
            );
        self.operations
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .insert(
                view.id.clone(),
                Operation {
                    view: view.clone(),
                    skill,
                    owner: String::new(),
                    cancelled: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
                    project_id: project_id.map(str::to_string),
                    old: None,
                    old_full_hash: None,
                    preview: None,
                    bypass: false,
                },
            );
        Ok(view)
    }
    pub(super) fn copy_local_archive(
        &self,
        id: &str,
        output: &Path,
        cancelled: &AtomicBool,
    ) -> CompanyResult<()> {
        let source = self
            .local_sources
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| operation_error())?
            .get(id)
            .cloned()
            .ok_or_else(operation_error)?;
        validate_ancestors(&source.path)?;
        let mut input = File::open(&source.path).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        let mut destination = File::create(output).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        let mut buffer = [0u8; 65_536];
        let mut size = 0u64;
        loop {
            Self::check_cancel(cancelled)?;
            let count = input.read(&mut buffer).map_err(|_| write_error())?;
            if count == 0 {
                break;
            }
            size += count as u64;
            if size > MAX_ARCHIVE || size > source.meta.size_bytes {
                return Err(CompanyError::new(
                    "PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
                    "File local đã thay đổi sau khi chọn.",
                ));
            }
            destination
                .write_all(&buffer[..count])
                .map_err(|_| write_error())?;
            self.update(id, OperationState::Downloading, Some(size), None);
        }
        destination.sync_all().map_err(|_| write_error())?;
        if size != source.meta.size_bytes {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
                "File local đã thay đổi sau khi chọn.",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

use super::types::{CompanyError, CompanyResult, PackageMeta};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    fs::{self, File},
    io::{Read, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

pub const MAX_ARCHIVE: u64 = 100 * 1_048_576;
pub const MAX_EXPANDED: u64 = 500 * 1_048_576;
const MAX_ENTRIES: usize = 10_000;
const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 32;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct VerifiedPackage {
    pub original_root: PathBuf,
    pub content_hash: String,
    pub full_hash: String,
    pub archive_hash: String,
}
fn invalid(message: &str) -> CompanyError {
    CompanyError::new("INVALID_PACKAGE", message)
}
fn io_error() -> CompanyError {
    CompanyError::new("WRITE_FAILED", "Không đọc/ghi được dữ liệu gói trên máy.")
}

pub fn validate_slug(slug: &str) -> CompanyResult<()> {
    if slug.is_empty()
        || slug.len() > 64
        || !slug.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_alphanumeric()
        || !slug
            .bytes()
            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit() || c == b'-' || c == b'_')
        || reserved(slug)
    {
        return Err(invalid("Tên thư mục skill không hợp lệ trên Windows."));
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn reserved(name: &str) -> bool {
    let base = name
        .split('.')
        .next()
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .to_ascii_uppercase();
    matches!(base.as_str(), "CON" | "PRN" | "AUX" | "NUL")
        || (base.len() == 4
            && (base.starts_with("COM") || base.starts_with("LPT"))
            && matches!(base.as_bytes()[3], b'1'..=b'9'))
}
pub fn checked_entry(name: &str) -> CompanyResult<PathBuf> {
    let normalized = name.replace('\\', "/");
    let text = normalized.trim_end_matches('/');
    if text.is_empty() || normalized.starts_with('/') {
        return Err(invalid("Gói có đường dẫn tuyệt đối hoặc rỗng."));
    }
    let parts: Vec<_> = text.split('/').collect();
    if parts.len() > MAX_DEPTH {
        return Err(invalid("Gói vượt giới hạn độ sâu thư mục."));
    }
    for part in &parts {
        if part.is_empty()
            || matches!(*part, "." | "..")
            || part.ends_with('.')
            || part.ends_with(' ')
            || reserved(part)
            || part
                .chars()
                .any(|c| c.is_control() || "<>:\"|?*".contains(c))
        {
            return Err(invalid(
                "Gói có đường dẫn không an toàn hoặc tên file không hợp lệ.",
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(parts.iter().collect())
}
pub fn reject_links(path: &Path) -> CompanyResult<()> {
    let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    let mut link = metadata.file_type().is_symlink();
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::fs::MetadataExt;
        link |= metadata.file_attributes() & 0x400 != 0;
    }
    if link {
        Err(invalid("Không chấp nhận symlink hoặc junction."))
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}
pub fn hash_file(path: &Path) -> CompanyResult<String> {
    let mut file = File::open(path).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    let mut hash = Sha256::new();
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 65_536];
    loop {
        let count = file.read(&mut buffer).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        if count == 0 {
            break;
        }
        hash.update(&buffer[..count]);
    }
    Ok(hex::encode(hash.finalize()))
}
pub fn content_hash(root: &Path, comparison: bool) -> CompanyResult<String> {
    let mut records = Vec::new();
    for entry in walkdir::WalkDir::new(root)
        .follow_links(false)
        .into_iter()
        .filter_entry(|entry| {
            !comparison || !excluded(entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().as_ref())
        })
    {
        let entry = entry.map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        reject_links(entry.path())?;
        if entry.path() == root {
            continue;
        }
        let relative = entry
            .path()
            .strip_prefix(root)
            .map_err(|_| invalid("Đường dẫn nội dung không hợp lệ."))?
            .to_str()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("Tên file không đọc được."))?
            .replace('\\', "/");
        if entry.file_type().is_file() {
            records.push((relative, "file", Some(hash_file(entry.path())?)));
        } else if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
            let empty = fs::read_dir(entry.path())
                .map_err(|_| io_error())?
                .next()
                .is_none();
            if !comparison || empty {
                records.push((relative, "directory", None));
            }
        } else {
            return Err(invalid("Nội dung có loại file không hỗ trợ."));
        }
    }
    records.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));
    let encoded =
        serde_json::to_vec(&records).map_err(|_| invalid("Không lập được manifest nội dung."))?;
    Ok(hex::encode(Sha256::digest(encoded)))
}
pub(crate) fn excluded(name: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(name, ".git" | "__pycache__" | "Thumbs.db" | "desktop.ini") || name.ends_with(".pyc")
}

struct EntryPolicy {
    entries: usize,
    expanded: u64,
    names: HashMap<String, String>,
}
impl EntryPolicy {
    fn check(&mut self, name: &str, size: u64) -> CompanyResult<PathBuf> {
        let relative = checked_entry(name)?;
        self.entries += 1;
        self.expanded = self
            .expanded
            .checked_add(size)
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("Kích thước gói không hợp lệ."))?;
        if self.entries > MAX_ENTRIES || self.expanded > MAX_EXPANDED {
            return Err(invalid(
                "Gói vượt giới hạn số file hoặc dung lượng giải nén.",
            ));
        }
        let spelling = relative.to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
        if self
            .names
            .insert(spelling.to_lowercase(), spelling)
            .is_some()
        {
            return Err(invalid("Gói có entries trùng trên Windows."));
        }
        Ok(relative)
    }
}
fn write_entry(
    input: &mut dyn Read,
    path: &Path,
    directory: bool,
    remaining: &mut u64,
) -> CompanyResult<()> {
    if directory {
        fs::create_dir_all(path).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        return Ok(());
    }
    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
        fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    }
    let mut output = File::create(path).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 65_536];
    loop {
        let count = input
            .read(&mut buffer)
            .map_err(|_| invalid("Không giải nén được nội dung gói."))?;
        if count == 0 {
            break;
        }
        if count as u64 > *remaining {
            return Err(invalid("Dữ liệu thực tế vượt giới hạn giải nén."));
        }
        *remaining -= count as u64;
        output.write_all(&buffer[..count]).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    }
    output.sync_all().map_err(|_| io_error())
}

pub fn prepare_archive(
    archive: &Path,
    meta: &PackageMeta,
    slug: &str,
    packages: &Path,
) -> CompanyResult<VerifiedPackage> {
    validate_slug(slug)?;
    let length = fs::metadata(archive).map_err(|_| io_error())?.len();
    if length > MAX_ARCHIVE
        || meta.size_bytes != length
        || meta.sha256.len() != 64
        || hash_file(archive)? != meta.sha256
    {
        return Err(CompanyError::new(
            "PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
            "Gói tải không đúng kích thước hoặc SHA-256 đã chọn.",
        ));
    }
    fs::create_dir_all(packages).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    reject_links(packages)?;
    let scratch = tempfile::tempdir_in(packages).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    let extract = scratch.path().join("extracted");
    fs::create_dir(&extract).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    let mut policy = EntryPolicy {
        entries: 0,
        expanded: 0,
        names: HashMap::new(),
    };
    let mut remaining = MAX_EXPANDED;
    match meta.format.as_str() {
        "zip" => {
            let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(File::open(archive).map_err(|_| io_error())?)
                .map_err(|_| invalid("ZIP không hợp lệ."))?;
            if zip.len() > MAX_ENTRIES {
                return Err(invalid("Gói vượt giới hạn số entries."));
            }
            for index in 0..zip.len() {
                let mut entry = zip
                    .by_index(index)
                    .map_err(|_| invalid("Không đọc được ZIP entry."))?;
                let mode = entry.unix_mode().unwrap_or(0) & 0o170000;
                if entry.encrypted() || !matches!(mode, 0 | 0o100000 | 0o040000) {
                    return Err(invalid("ZIP có mã hóa hoặc link/file không hỗ trợ."));
                }
                let relative = policy.check(entry.name(), entry.size())?;
                let directory = entry.is_dir();
                write_entry(
                    &mut entry,
                    &extract.join(relative),
                    directory,
                    &mut remaining,
                )?;
            }
        }
        "7z" => {
            let mut reader =
                sevenz_rust::SevenZReader::open(archive, sevenz_rust::Password::empty())
                    .map_err(|_| invalid("7z không hợp lệ hoặc đã mã hóa."))?;
            for folder in &reader.archive().folders {
                for coder in &folder.coders {
                    let properties = &coder.properties;
                    let dictionary = match coder.decompression_method_id() {
                        [0x21] if properties.len() == 1 && properties[0] < 40 => {
                            (2u64 | (properties[0] as u64 & 1)) << (properties[0] as u64 / 2 + 11)
                        }
                        [0x03, 0x01, 0x01] if properties.len() >= 5 => {
                            u32::from_le_bytes(properties[1..5].try_into().unwrap()) as u64
                        }
                        [0x21] => u64::MAX,
                        _ => 0,
                    };
                    if dictionary > MAX_EXPANDED {
                        return Err(invalid("7z yêu cầu quá nhiều bộ nhớ giải nén."));
                    }
                }
            }
            for entry in &reader.archive().files {
                if entry.is_anti_item
                    || entry.windows_attributes & 0x400 != 0
                    || (entry.windows_attributes >> 16) & 0o170000 == 0o120000
                {
                    return Err(invalid("7z có link hoặc anti-item không hỗ trợ."));
                }
                policy.check(&entry.name, entry.size)?;
            }
            reader
                .for_each_entries(|entry, input| {
                    let path = checked_entry(&entry.name)
                        .map_err(|_| sevenz_rust::Error::other("unsafe path"))?;
                    write_entry(
                        input,
                        &extract.join(path),
                        entry.is_directory,
                        &mut remaining,
                    )
                    .map_err(|_| sevenz_rust::Error::other("invalid or oversized entry"))?;
                    Ok(true)
                })
                .map_err(|_| invalid("Không giải nén được 7z hoặc gói vượt giới hạn."))?;
        }
        _ => return Err(invalid("Định dạng gói phải là ZIP hoặc 7z.")),
    }
    let skill_root = if extract.join("SKILL.md").is_file() {
        extract.clone()
    } else {
        let entries: Vec<_> = fs::read_dir(&extract)
            .map_err(|_| io_error())?
            .collect::<Result<_, _>>()
            .map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        let wrapped = extract.join(slug);
        if entries.len() != 1 || !wrapped.join("SKILL.md").is_file() {
            return Err(invalid(
                "Gói phải có một SKILL.md ở root hoặc wrapper khớp slug.",
            ));
        }
        wrapped
    };
    let marker = fs::read_to_string(skill_root.join("SKILL.md"))
        .map_err(|_| invalid("SKILL.md phải là UTF-8 đọc được."))?;
    if marker.trim().is_empty() {
        return Err(invalid("SKILL.md không được rỗng."));
    }
    let full = content_hash(&skill_root, false)?;
    let comparison = content_hash(&skill_root, true)?;
    let destination = packages.join(&meta.sha256);
    if destination.exists() {
        reject_links(&destination)?;
        if content_hash(&destination.join("original"), false)? != full {
            return Err(invalid(
                "Bản gốc trong cache đã thay đổi. Kiểm tra dữ liệu app trước khi thử lại.",
            ));
        }
    } else {
        let prepared = scratch.path().join("package");
        fs::create_dir(&prepared).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        fs::rename(&skill_root, prepared.join("original")).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        fs::copy(archive, prepared.join(format!("archive.{}", meta.format)))
            .map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        fs::write(
            prepared.join("manifest.json"),
            serde_json::json!({"contentHash":comparison,"fullHash":full,"algorithm":"content-v1"})
                .to_string(),
        )
        .map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        fs::rename(prepared, &destination).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    }
    Ok(VerifiedPackage {
        original_root: destination.join("original"),
        content_hash: comparison,
        full_hash: full,
        archive_hash: meta.sha256.clone(),
    })
}

pub fn copy_tree(source: &Path, target: &Path) -> CompanyResult<()> {
    fs::create_dir_all(target).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
    for entry in walkdir::WalkDir::new(source).follow_links(false) {
        let entry = entry.map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        reject_links(entry.path())?;
        if entry.path() == source {
            continue;
        }
        let relative = entry.path().strip_prefix(source).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        let path = target.join(relative);
        if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
            fs::create_dir_all(path).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        } else if entry.file_type().is_file() {
            if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
                fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
            }
            fs::copy(entry.path(), &path).map_err(|_| io_error())?;
            File::options()
                .write(true)
                .open(path)
                .map_err(|_| io_error())?
                .sync_all()
                .map_err(|_| io_error())?;
        } else {
            return Err(invalid("Không sao chép loại file không hỗ trợ."));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
