````rust
use super::{config::CompanyConfig, types::*};
use reqwest::blocking::{Client, Response};
use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::{io::Read, time::Duration};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct StoreClient {
    client: Client,
    base_url: String,
}
impl StoreClient {
    pub fn new(config: &CompanyConfig) -> CompanyResult<Self> {
        config.validate()?;
        let client = Client::builder()
            .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(120))
            .build()
            .map_err(|_| CompanyError::new("NETWORK_ERROR", "Không khởi tạo được HTTP client."))?;
        Ok(Self {
            client,
            base_url: config.store_url.clone(),
        })
    }
    pub(crate) fn endpoint(&self, path: &str) -> CompanyResult<String> {
        if self.base_url.is_empty() {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "CONFIGURATION_ERROR",
                "Chưa cấu hình Skill Store.",
            ));
        }
        Ok(format!("{}/api/v1{}", self.base_url, path))
    }
    pub(crate) fn response_error(response: Response) -> CompanyError {
        let retry_after_seconds = response
            .headers()
            .get(reqwest::header::RETRY_AFTER)
            .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
            .and_then(|value| value.parse().ok());
        let status = response.status().as_u16();
        let fallback = match status {
            401 => "UNAUTHENTICATED",
            403 => "FORBIDDEN",
            404 => "SKILL_NOT_FOUND",
            412 => "PACKAGE_CHANGED",
            429 => "RATE_LIMITED",
            503 => "STORE_UNAVAILABLE",
            _ => "STORE_ERROR",
        };
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        let _ = response.take(65_536).read_to_end(&mut bytes);
        let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        let error = &value["error"];
        CompanyError {
            code: error["code"].as_str().unwrap_or(fallback).to_string(),
            message: error["message"]
                .as_str()
                .unwrap_or("Skill Store không thể hoàn tất yêu cầu.")
                .chars()
                .take(512)
                .collect(),
            request_id: error["request_id"].as_str().map(str::to_string),
            retry_after_seconds,
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn decode<T: DeserializeOwned>(response: Response) -> CompanyResult<T> {
        if !response.status().is_success() {
            return Err(Self::response_error(response));
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        response
            .take(2_097_153)
            .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
            .map_err(|_| Self::network_error())?;
        if bytes.len() > 2_097_152 {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "INVALID_RESPONSE",
                "Phản hồi Store vượt giới hạn.",
            ));
        }
        let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
            .map_err(|_| CompanyError::new("INVALID_RESPONSE", "Store không trả JSON hợp lệ."))?;
        serde_json::from_value(value["data"].clone()).map_err(|_| {
            CompanyError::new("INVALID_RESPONSE", "Dữ liệu Store không đúng hợp đồng API.")
        })
    }
    pub(crate) fn network_error() -> CompanyError {
        CompanyError::new(
            "NETWORK_ERROR",
            "Không kết nối được Skill Store. Kiểm tra mạng nội bộ và thử lại.",
        )
    }
    pub fn login(&self, username: &str, password: &str) -> CompanyResult<StoredSession> {
        let response = self
            .client
            .post(self.endpoint("/auth/login")?)
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(15))
            .json(&json!({"username":username,"password":password}))
            .send()
            .map_err(|_| Self::network_error())?;
        Self::decode(response)
    }
    pub fn logout(&self, token: &str) -> CompanyResult<()> {
        let response = self
            .client
            .post(self.endpoint("/auth/logout")?)
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(15))
            .bearer_auth(token)
            .send()
            .map_err(|_| Self::network_error())?;
        if response.status().as_u16() == 204 {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(Self::response_error(response))
        }
    }
    pub fn search(&self, token: &str, query: &str, page: u32) -> CompanyResult<SkillPage> {
        if query.chars().count() > 200 || page == 0 {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "VALIDATION_ERROR",
                "Từ khóa hoặc số trang không hợp lệ.",
            ));
        }
        Self::decode(
            self.client
                .get(self.endpoint("/skills")?)
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(15))
                .bearer_auth(token)
                .query(&[
                    ("q", query.trim()),
                    ("page", &page.to_string()),
                    ("page_size", "20"),
                ])
                .send()
                .map_err(|_| Self::network_error())?,
        )
    }
    pub fn detail(&self, token: &str, id: &str) -> CompanyResult<Skill> {
        let detail: Skill = Self::decode(
            self.client
                .get(self.endpoint(&format!("/skills/{}", urlencoding::encode(id)))?)
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(15))
                .bearer_auth(token)
                .send()
                .map_err(|_| Self::network_error())?,
        )?;
        if detail.id != id || detail.description.is_none() {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "INVALID_RESPONSE",
                "Detail không khớp định danh skill hoặc thiếu description đầy đủ.",
            ));
        }
        Ok(detail)
    }
    pub fn package_response(&self, token: &str, id: &str, etag: &str) -> CompanyResult<Response> {
        let response = self
            .client
            .get(self.endpoint(&format!("/skills/{}/package", urlencoding::encode(id)))?)
            .bearer_auth(token)
            .header(reqwest::header::IF_MATCH, etag)
            .send()
            .map_err(|_| Self::network_error())?;
        if response.status().as_u16() != 200 {
            return Err(Self::response_error(response));
        }
        if response
            .headers()
            .get(reqwest::header::ETAG)
            .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
            != Some(etag)
        {
            return Err(CompanyError::new(
                "PACKAGE_CHANGED",
                "ETag gói tải không khớp thông tin đã chọn.",
            ));
        }
        Ok(response)
    }
}
````

````rust
//! Showing a path in the operating system's file manager.
//!
//! The three-way platform split lives here once. It already existed in three
//! places (the tray, the Settings button, and the log-export reveal), and a
//! fourth copy — for a project's folder — is how they drift apart.
//!
//! Command construction is pure so the branches can be asserted in tests
//! without launching a file manager on the machine running them.

use std::ffi::OsString;
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::{Command, ExitStatus};

/// What to do with the path.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FileManagerAction {
    /// Show the directory's contents.
    OpenDir,
    /// Show the directory that contains this entry, with the entry selected.
    ///
    /// Not the same as `OpenDir` on a directory: it answers "where does this
    /// live?" rather than "what is in it?".
    RevealItem,
}

/// The program and arguments for an action, without running anything.
///
/// Arguments are returned unquoted. `Command` escapes them for the platform,
/// and pre-quoting would leave the quotes inside the path. They stay `OsString`
/// so a path that is not valid UTF-8 reaches the file manager byte for byte.
pub fn file_manager_command(path: &Path, action: FileManagerAction) -> (String, Vec<OsString>) {
    let shown = path.as_os_str().to_owned();

    if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        match action {
            FileManagerAction::OpenDir => ("open".into(), vec![shown]),
            FileManagerAction::RevealItem => ("open".into(), vec!["-R".into(), shown]),
        }
    } else if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
        match action {
            FileManagerAction::OpenDir => ("explorer".into(), vec![shown]),
            // explorer takes the selection as one argument, path included.
            FileManagerAction::RevealItem => {
                let mut select = OsString::from("/select,");
                select.push(shown);
                ("explorer".into(), vec![select])
            }
        }
    } else {
        match action {
            FileManagerAction::OpenDir => ("xdg-open".into(), vec![shown]),
            // xdg-open cannot select an entry, so the containing directory is
            // the closest thing to revealing one. A path with no parent is its
            // own location.
            FileManagerAction::RevealItem => {
                let target = path.parent().unwrap_or(path).as_os_str().to_owned();
                ("xdg-open".into(), vec![target])
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Run the action.
///
/// Returns the exit status rather than judging it, because callers disagree on
/// what a failure means: a button reports it to the user, a tray item logs it,
/// and the reveal after an export ignores it. Windows `explorer.exe` exits
/// non-zero even on success, so callers on that platform must not test it.
///
/// Deliberately not covered by tests: running it would launch a file manager on
/// the machine running them.
pub fn run(path: &Path, action: FileManagerAction) -> std::io::Result<ExitStatus> {
    let (program, args) = file_manager_command(path, action);
    let mut command = Command::new(program);

    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        // CREATE_NO_WINDOW: explorer would otherwise flash a console window.
        command.creation_flags(0x08000000);
    }

    command.args(args).status()
}

/// Whether a file manager's exit status means the open failed.
///
/// Windows `explorer.exe` exits non-zero even on success, so its status is
/// never a failure; every other platform reports one with a non-zero status.
/// Uses `cfg!` the way the command builder does, so the branch compiles (and is
/// testable) on every platform.
pub fn exit_is_failure(success: bool) -> bool {
    if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
        let _ = success;
        false
    } else {
        !success
    }
}

/// Show a directory's contents in the file manager.
pub fn open_dir(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<ExitStatus> {
    run(path, FileManagerAction::OpenDir)
}

/// Show an entry in its containing directory, selected where the platform can.
pub fn reveal_item(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<ExitStatus> {
    run(path, FileManagerAction::RevealItem)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// A path with spaces and non-ASCII characters must leave here as one
    /// unquoted argument: quoting is `Command`'s job, and doing it here would
    /// put the quotes in the path.
    #[test]
    fn opening_a_directory_passes_the_path_as_one_unquoted_argument() {
        let (program, args) = file_manager_command(
            Path::new("/tmp/My Projects/技能库"),
            FileManagerAction::OpenDir,
        );

        assert_eq!(args, vec![OsString::from("/tmp/My Projects/技能库")]);
        assert_eq!(
            program,
            if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
                "open"
            } else if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
                "explorer"
            } else {
                "xdg-open"
            }
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn revealing_targets_the_entry_not_its_contents() {
        let path = Path::new("/tmp/My Projects/技能库");
        let (program, args) = file_manager_command(path, FileManagerAction::RevealItem);

        if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
            assert_eq!(program, "open");
            // -R must precede the path, or `open` reads it as a file to launch.
            assert_eq!(
                args,
                vec![OsString::from("-R"), OsString::from("/tmp/My Projects/技能库")]
            );
        } else if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
            assert_eq!(program, "explorer");
            // explorer wants the path inside the single /select argument.
            assert_eq!(args, vec![OsString::from("/select,/tmp/My Projects/技能库")]);
        } else {
            assert_eq!(program, "xdg-open");
            // No selection concept, so the containing directory is opened.
            assert_eq!(args, vec![OsString::from("/tmp/My Projects")]);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn no_platform_produces_an_empty_argument() {
        // A path with no parent must still yield something runnable.
        let (_, args) = file_manager_command(Path::new("/"), FileManagerAction::RevealItem);

        assert!(!args.is_empty());
        assert!(args.iter().all(|arg| !arg.is_empty()), "{args:?}");
    }

    /// Linux paths are bytes, not text. Rendering one through `display()` would
    /// swap an invalid byte for U+FFFD and open a different (missing) path.
    #[cfg(unix)]
    #[test]
    fn a_non_utf8_path_reaches_the_file_manager_unchanged() {
        use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;

        let raw = std::ffi::OsStr::from_bytes(b"/tmp/caf\xe9");
        let (_, args) = file_manager_command(Path::new(raw), FileManagerAction::OpenDir);

        assert_eq!(args.last().map(|arg| arg.as_bytes()), Some(raw.as_bytes()));
    }

    /// A clean exit is never a failure; a non-zero one is, except on Windows
    /// where `explorer.exe` reports success with a non-zero code.
    #[test]
    fn a_nonzero_exit_is_a_failure_except_on_windows() {
        assert!(!exit_is_failure(true));
        assert_eq!(exit_is_failure(false), !cfg!(target_os = "windows"));
    }
}
````

````rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// Top-level grouping for sidebar/overview display. Does not affect skill
/// deployment, sync, or any other backend behavior — purely a UI taxonomy.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum ToolCategory {
    /// Coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.). The default.
    #[default]
    Coding,
    /// Lobster-class personal AI assistants (OpenClaw ecosystem, Hermes Agent).
    Lobster,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct ToolAdapter {
    pub key: String,
    pub display_name: String,
    pub relative_skills_dir: String,
    pub relative_detect_dir: String,
    /// Additional directories to scan for skills (e.g. plugin/marketplace dirs).
    /// These are only used for discovery, not for deployment.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub additional_scan_dirs: Vec<String>,
    /// When set, overrides the computed skills_dir with this absolute path.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub override_skills_dir: Option<String>,
    /// Whether this is a user-defined custom agent (not built-in).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub is_custom: bool,
    /// When true, scan the skills directory recursively for skill directories
    /// (directories containing SKILL.md) instead of treating immediate children as skills.
    /// Used by tools with nested category directories (e.g., Hermes Agent).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub recursive_scan: bool,
    /// Optional override for the project-level skills path. When `None`, the
    /// project-level path falls back to `relative_skills_dir`. Used by tools
    /// like OpenCode where the global path (`~/.config/opencode/skills`)
    /// differs from the project path (`.opencode/skills`).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub project_relative_skills_dir: Option<String>,
    /// UI grouping. See [`ToolCategory`].
    #[serde(default)]
    pub category: ToolCategory,
}

/// Serializable custom tool definition stored in settings.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CustomToolDef {
    pub key: String,
    pub display_name: String,
    pub skills_dir: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub project_relative_skills_dir: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub category: ToolCategory,
}

impl ToolAdapter {
    fn home() -> PathBuf {
        dirs::home_dir().expect("Cannot determine home directory")
    }

    fn candidate_paths(relative: &str) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
        let mut candidates = vec![Self::home().join(relative)];

        if let Some(suffix) = relative.strip_prefix(".config/") {
            if let Some(config_dir) = dirs::config_dir() {
                let config_path = config_dir.join(suffix);
                if !candidates.contains(&config_path) {
                    candidates.push(config_path);
                }
            }
        }

        candidates
    }

    fn select_existing_or_default(paths: &[PathBuf]) -> PathBuf {
        paths
            .iter()
            .find(|path| path.exists())
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| paths[0].clone())
    }

    pub fn skills_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {
        if let Some(ref abs) = self.override_skills_dir {
            return PathBuf::from(abs);
        }
        let candidates = Self::candidate_paths(&self.relative_skills_dir);
        Self::select_existing_or_default(&candidates)
    }

    /// Project-relative skills path used when scanning workspaces. Falls back
    /// to `relative_skills_dir` when no project-specific override is set.
    pub fn project_relative_skills_dir(&self) -> &str {
        self.project_relative_skills_dir
            .as_deref()
            .unwrap_or(&self.relative_skills_dir)
    }

    /// Returns all directories to scan for skills: the primary skills_dir plus any additional scan dirs.
    pub fn all_scan_dirs(&self) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
        let mut dirs = vec![self.skills_dir()];
        for c in self.additional_existing_scan_dirs() {
            if !dirs.contains(&c) {
                dirs.push(c);
            }
        }
        dirs
    }

    /// Returns the existing additional discovery roots for this adapter.
    pub fn additional_existing_scan_dirs(&self) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
        let mut dirs = Vec::new();
        for rel in &self.additional_scan_dirs {
            let candidates = Self::candidate_paths(rel);
            for c in candidates {
                if c.exists() && !dirs.contains(&c) {
                    dirs.push(c);
                }
            }
        }
        dirs
    }

    pub fn is_installed(&self) -> bool {
        // Product decision: when users explicitly provide a skills path (override/custom),
        // we treat the tool as available so sync can proceed without probing vendor install state.
        if self.is_custom || self.override_skills_dir.is_some() {
            return true;
        }
        Self::candidate_paths(&self.relative_detect_dir)
            .iter()
            .any(|path| path.exists())
    }

    /// Whether this adapter's skills_dir has been overridden from the default.
    pub fn has_path_override(&self) -> bool {
        self.override_skills_dir.is_some()
    }
}

pub fn default_tool_adapters() -> Vec<ToolAdapter> {

            key: "omp_agent".into(),

            // bundled Duo CLI binary, not the documentation.
            key: "gitlab_duo".into(),

/// Read custom tool path overrides from store.
pub fn custom_tool_paths(store: &crate::core::skill_store::SkillStore) -> HashMap<String, String> {
    store
        .get_setting("custom_tool_paths")
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_str(&v).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// Read per-tool project-relative skills path overrides for built-in adapters.
/// Maps tool key -> project-relative path (e.g. `.cursor/skills`). Custom tools
/// store their project path inside [`CustomToolDef`] instead.
pub fn custom_tool_project_paths(
    store: &crate::core::skill_store::SkillStore,
) -> HashMap<String, String> {
    store
        .get_setting("custom_tool_project_paths")
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_str(&v).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// Read user-defined custom tools from store.
pub fn custom_tools(store: &crate::core::skill_store::SkillStore) -> Vec<CustomToolDef> {
    store
        .get_setting("custom_tools")
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_str(&v).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn apply_builtin_path_overrides(
    adapter: &mut ToolAdapter,
    overrides: &HashMap<String, String>,
    project_overrides: &HashMap<String, String>,
) {
    if let Some(path) = overrides.get(&adapter.key) {
        adapter.override_skills_dir = Some(path.clone());
    }

    if let Some(project_path) = project_overrides.get(&adapter.key) {
        adapter.project_relative_skills_dir = Some(project_path.clone());
    }
}

fn custom_tool_adapter(ct: CustomToolDef) -> ToolAdapter {
    ToolAdapter {
        key: ct.key,
        display_name: ct.display_name,
        relative_skills_dir: ct.project_relative_skills_dir.unwrap_or_default(),
        relative_detect_dir: String::new(),
        additional_scan_dirs: vec![],
        override_skills_dir: Some(ct.skills_dir),
        category: ct.category,
        is_custom: true,
        recursive_scan: false,
        project_relative_skills_dir: None,
    }
}

/// Returns all tool adapters: built-in (with path overrides applied) + custom tools.
pub fn all_tool_adapters(store: &crate::core::skill_store::SkillStore) -> Vec<ToolAdapter> {
    let overrides = custom_tool_paths(store);
    let project_overrides = custom_tool_project_paths(store);
    let customs = custom_tools(store);

    let mut adapters: Vec<ToolAdapter> = default_tool_adapters()
        .into_iter()
        .map(|mut adapter| {
            apply_builtin_path_overrides(&mut adapter, &overrides, &project_overrides);
            adapter
        })
        .collect();

    for custom in customs {
        if adapters.iter().any(|adapter| adapter.key == custom.key) {
            continue;
        }
        adapters.push(custom_tool_adapter(custom));
    }

    adapters
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub fn find_adapter(key: &str) -> Option<ToolAdapter> {
    default_tool_adapters().into_iter().find(|a| a.key == key)
}

/// Find an adapter by key, considering custom tools and path overrides.
pub fn find_adapter_with_store(
    store: &crate::core::skill_store::SkillStore,
    key: &str,
) -> Option<ToolAdapter> {
    let overrides = custom_tool_paths(store);
    let project_overrides = custom_tool_project_paths(store);
    let customs = custom_tools(store);

    if let Some(mut adapter) = default_tool_adapters().into_iter().find(|a| a.key == key) {
        apply_builtin_path_overrides(&mut adapter, &overrides, &project_overrides);
        return Some(adapter);
    }

    customs
        .into_iter()
        .find(|ct| ct.key == key)
        .map(custom_tool_adapter)
}

/// Returns adapters that are installed and not in the disabled list.
pub fn enabled_installed_adapters(
    store: &crate::core::skill_store::SkillStore,
) -> Vec<ToolAdapter> {
    let disabled: Vec<String> = store
        .get_setting("disabled_tools")
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_str(&v).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    all_tool_adapters(store)
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|a| a.is_installed() && !disabled.contains(&a.key))
        .collect()
}

mod tests {

        let tmp = tempdir().unwrap();
        let store = SkillStore::new(&tmp.path().join("test.db")).unwrap();
        let custom_skills = tmp.path().join("custom-skills");
        let custom_project_path = ".custom/skills";

            CustomToolDef {
                key: "omp_agent".to_string(),
                display_name: "Legacy Custom OMP".to_string(),
                skills_dir: tmp.path().join("legacy-skills").to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                project_relative_skills_dir: Some(".legacy/skills".to_string()),
                category: ToolCategory::Lobster,
            },
            CustomToolDef {
                key: "custom_agent".to_string(),
                display_name: "Custom Agent".to_string(),
                skills_dir: custom_skills.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                project_relative_skills_dir: Some(custom_project_path.to_string()),
                category: ToolCategory::Lobster,
            },
        ];
        store
            .set_setting("custom_tools", &serde_json::to_string(&custom_tools).unwrap())
            .unwrap();

            .iter()

        assert_eq!(adapter.relative_skills_dir, ".omp/agent/skills");
        assert_eq!(adapter.relative_detect_dir, ".omp/agent");
        assert_eq!(adapter.project_relative_skills_dir(), ".omp/skills");

        let custom_adapter = adapters
            .iter()
            .find(|adapter| adapter.key == "custom_agent")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(custom_adapter.display_name, "Custom Agent");
        assert!(custom_adapter.is_custom);

        assert_eq!(custom_adapter.skills_dir(), custom_skills);
        assert_eq!(custom_adapter.project_relative_skills_dir(), custom_project_path);

        let found = find_adapter_with_store(&store, "omp_agent").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(found.display_name, "OMP Agent");
        assert!(!found.is_custom);
        assert_eq!(found.category, ToolCategory::Coding);
        assert_eq!(found.relative_skills_dir, ".omp/agent/skills");
        assert_eq!(found.relative_detect_dir, ".omp/agent");
        assert_eq!(found.project_relative_skills_dir(), ".omp/skills");

    #[test]
````

````rust
use super::{support::MockServer, wait_operation};
use app_lib::core::company::{
    config::CompanyConfig,
    installation_repository::CompanyRepository,
    installation_service::CompanyService,
    package_store::{content_hash, copy_tree},
    session::MemoryCredentials,
    types::*,
};
use std::{
    fs,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::Arc,
};

#[test]
fn company_flow06_recovery_never_deletes_a_new_owner_even_with_identical_snapshot_bytes() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let server = MockServer::start("normal");
    let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
        &server.url,
        root.path().join("profile"),
        root.path().join("data"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let credentials = Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default());
    let app = Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config.clone(), credentials.clone()).unwrap());
    app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
    let install = app.prepare_install("skl_003").unwrap();
    app.confirm(&install.id, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        wait_operation(&app, &install.id).state,
        OperationState::Succeeded
    );
    let old = app.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
    let remove = app.prepare_remove(&old.id).unwrap();
    app.apply_lifecycle(&remove.id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        wait_operation(&app, &remove.id).state,
        OperationState::Succeeded
    );
    let backup = app.backups(&old.id).unwrap().remove(0);
    let view = app.prepare_restore(&backup.id).unwrap();
    let removed = app.refresh_installation(&old.id).unwrap();
    let repo = CompanyRepository::open(&config.data_root.join("manager.db")).unwrap();
    let mut new = backup.installation.clone();
    new.state = InstallationState::Active;
    let journal = LifecycleJournal {
        view,
        old: removed,
        new,
        old_full_hash: None,
        new_full_hash: Some(backup.full_hash.clone()),
        current_backup: None,
        source_backup: Some(backup),
        phase: ReplacePhase::NewMoved,
        stage_owned: true,
    };
    // An external/previous app run has already placed a new managed owner at
    // the same target; equal hashes alone cannot establish journal ownership.
    let fresh = app.prepare_install("skl_003").unwrap();
    app.confirm(&fresh.id, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        wait_operation(&app, &fresh.id).state,
        OperationState::Succeeded
    );
    let active = app
        .installations()
        .unwrap()
        .into_iter()
        .find(|i| i.state == InstallationState::Active)
        .unwrap();
    let before = fs::read(Path::new(&active.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap();
    repo.record_lifecycle(&journal).unwrap();
    drop(repo);
    drop(app);
    let restarted = CompanyService::new(config, credentials).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(Path::new(&active.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap(),
        before
    );
    assert!(!restarted.recovery_warnings().is_empty());
}

#[cfg(windows)]
#[test]
fn company_flow06_recovery_retains_rollback_when_a_writer_can_still_edit_after_verification() {
    use std::os::windows::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let server = MockServer::start("normal");
    let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
        &server.url,
        root.path().join("profile"),
        root.path().join("data"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let credentials = Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default());
    let app = Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config.clone(), credentials.clone()).unwrap());
    app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
    let install = app.prepare_install("skl_003").unwrap();
    app.confirm(&install.id, false).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        wait_operation(&app, &install.id).state,
        OperationState::Succeeded
    );
    let old = app.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
    let remove = app.prepare_remove(&old.id).unwrap();
    app.apply_lifecycle(&remove.id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        wait_operation(&app, &remove.id).state,
        OperationState::Succeeded
    );
    let backup = app.backups(&old.id).unwrap().remove(0);
    let repo = CompanyRepository::open(&config.data_root.join("manager.db")).unwrap();
    let new = repo.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
    let rollback = Path::new(&old.target)
        .parent()
        .unwrap()
        .join(format!(".company-rollback-{}", remove.id));
    copy_tree(Path::new(&backup.path), &rollback).unwrap();
    let journal = LifecycleJournal {
        view: remove,
        old: backup.installation.clone(),
        new,
        old_full_hash: Some(backup.full_hash.clone()),
        new_full_hash: None,
        current_backup: Some(backup),
        source_backup: None,
        phase: ReplacePhase::Committed,
        stage_owned: false,
    };
    repo.record_lifecycle(&journal).unwrap();
    drop(repo);
    drop(app);
    // Read/write/delete sharing lets the old implementation hash and unlink
    // this file even though the writer can still change its bytes at any time.
    let writer = fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .write(true)
        .share_mode(7)
        .open(rollback.join("SKILL.md"))
        .unwrap();
    let restarted = CompanyService::new(config, credentials).unwrap();
    assert!(rollback.join("SKILL.md").exists());
    assert!(!restarted.recovery_warnings().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        restarted
            .delete_backup(&journal.current_backup.as_ref().unwrap().id)
            .unwrap_err()
            .code,
        "BACKUP_IN_USE"
    );
    drop(writer);
}

// Seed actual file/SQLite states at each interrupted operation boundary. Observe
// recovery only through the public service after restart.
#[test]
fn company_flow06_recovery_restores_or_keeps_committed_state_at_all_rename_boundaries() {
    for kind in ["remove", "restore_present", "restore_absent"] {
        for checkpoint in 0..6 {
            let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
            let server = MockServer::start("normal");
            let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
                &server.url,
                root.path().join("profile"),
                root.path().join("data"),
            )
            .unwrap();
            let credentials = Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default());
            let app = Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config.clone(), credentials.clone()).unwrap());
            app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
            let install = app.prepare_install("skl_003").unwrap();
            app.confirm(&install.id, false).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                wait_operation(&app, &install.id).state,
                OperationState::Succeeded
            );
            let item = app.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
            let target = PathBuf::from(&item.target);
            fs::write(target.join("SKILL.md"), "Snapshot customized content").unwrap();
            let remove = app.prepare_remove(&item.id).unwrap();
            app.apply_lifecycle(&remove.id).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                wait_operation(&app, &remove.id).state,
                OperationState::Succeeded
            );
            let source = app.backups(&item.id).unwrap().remove(0);
            if kind != "restore_absent" {
                let restore = app.prepare_restore(&source.id).unwrap();
                app.apply_lifecycle(&restore.id).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(
                    wait_operation(&app, &restore.id).state,
                    OperationState::Succeeded
                );
                fs::write(
                    target.join("SKILL.md"),
                    "Current copy before interrupted operation",
                )
                .unwrap();
            }
            let view = if kind == "remove" {
                app.prepare_remove(&item.id).unwrap()
            } else {
                app.prepare_restore(&source.id).unwrap()
            };
            let repo = CompanyRepository::open(&config.data_root.join("manager.db")).unwrap();
            let old = repo.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
            let old_hash = if target.exists() {
                Some(content_hash(&target, false).unwrap())
            } else {
                None
            };
            let current_backup = old_hash.as_ref().map(|hash| {
                let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
                let path = config
                    .data_root
                    .join("backups")
                    .join(&old.id)
                    .join(&id)
                    .join("content");
                copy_tree(&target, &path).unwrap();
                let backup = Backup {
                    id,
                    installation_id: old.id.clone(),
                    created_at: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z".into(),
                    reason: kind.into(),
                    path: path.display().to_string(),
                    full_hash: hash.clone(),
                    installation: old.clone(),
                };
                fs::write(
                    path.parent().unwrap().join("metadata.json"),
                    serde_json::to_vec(&backup).unwrap(),
                )
                .unwrap();
                repo.save_backup(&backup).unwrap();
                backup
            });
            let mut new = if kind == "remove" {
                old.clone()
            } else {
                source.installation.clone()
            };
            new.state = if kind == "remove" {
                InstallationState::Removed
            } else {
                InstallationState::Active
            };
            let stage = app_lib::core::company::aipro_paths::stage_path(&target, &view.id).unwrap();
            let rollback = target
                .parent()
                .unwrap()
                .join(format!(".company-rollback-{}", view.id));
            let restoring = kind != "remove";
            if restoring {
                copy_tree(Path::new(&source.path), &stage).unwrap();
            }
            let mut journal = LifecycleJournal {
                view,
                old,
                new,
                old_full_hash: old_hash,
                new_full_hash: restoring.then(|| source.full_hash.clone()),
                current_backup,
                source_backup: restoring.then_some(source),
                phase: ReplacePhase::Prepared,
                stage_owned: restoring,
            };
            repo.record_lifecycle(&journal).unwrap();
            if checkpoint >= 1 && journal.old_full_hash.is_some() {
                fs::rename(&target, &rollback).unwrap();
            }
            if checkpoint >= 2 {
                journal.phase = ReplacePhase::OldMoved;
                repo.record_lifecycle(&journal).unwrap();
            }
            if checkpoint >= 3 && restoring {
                fs::rename(&stage, &target).unwrap();
            }
            if checkpoint >= 4 {
                journal.phase = ReplacePhase::NewMoved;
                repo.record_lifecycle(&journal).unwrap();
            }
            if checkpoint >= 5 {
                journal.phase = ReplacePhase::Committed;
                repo.commit_lifecycle(&journal).unwrap();
            }
            drop(repo);
            drop(app);
            let restarted = CompanyService::new(config, credentials).unwrap();
            assert!(
                restarted.recovery_warnings().is_empty(),
                "{kind} checkpoint {checkpoint}: {:?}",
                restarted.recovery_warnings()
            );
            let observed = restarted.refresh_installation(&item.id).unwrap();
            let expected = if checkpoint == 5 {
                journal.new.state
            } else {
                journal.old.state
            };
            assert_eq!(observed.state, expected, "{kind} checkpoint {checkpoint}");
            if expected == InstallationState::Active {
                let expected_text = if checkpoint == 5 {
                    "Snapshot customized content"
                } else {
                    "Current copy before interrupted operation"
                };
                assert_eq!(
                    fs::read_to_string(target.join("SKILL.md")).unwrap(),
                    expected_text,
                    "{kind} checkpoint {checkpoint}"
                );
            } else {
                assert!(!target.exists());
            }
            assert!(!stage.exists());
            assert!(!rollback.exists());
        }
    }
}
````

````rust
use super::{support::MockServer, wait_operation};
use app_lib::core::company::{
    config::CompanyConfig, installation_service::CompanyService, session::MemoryCredentials,
};
use std::{fs, path::Path, sync::Arc};

fn completed(app: &Arc<CompanyService>, id: &str) {
    let view = wait_operation(app, id);
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(&view).unwrap()["state"],
        "succeeded",
        "{:?}",
        view.error
    );
}

#[test]
fn company_flow06_remove_and_update_cannot_hold_conflicting_decisions_for_one_target() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let revision = root.path().join("revision");
    fs::write(&revision, "1").unwrap();
    let server = MockServer::start_with_revision("normal", Some(&revision));
    let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
        &server.url,
        root.path().join("profile"),
        root.path().join("data"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let app =
        Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config, Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default())).unwrap());
    app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
    let op = app.prepare_install("skl_001").unwrap();
    app.confirm(&op.id, true).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &op.id);
    let item = app.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
    let remove = app.prepare_remove(&item.id).unwrap();
    fs::write(&revision, "2").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        app.prepare_update(&item.id).unwrap_err().code,
        "TARGET_BUSY"
    );
    app.cancel(&remove.id).unwrap();
    assert!(app.prepare_update(&item.id).is_ok());
}

#[test]
fn company_flow06_restore_reactivates_the_archived_project_without_recreating_its_root() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let server = MockServer::start("normal");
    let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
        &server.url,
        root.path().join("profile"),
        root.path().join("data"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let app =
        Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config, Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default())).unwrap());
    app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
    let folder = root.path().join("Project");
    fs::create_dir(&folder).unwrap();
    let project = app.add_project(&folder).unwrap();
    let op = app.prepare_project_install("skl_003", &project.id).unwrap();
    app.confirm(&op.id, false).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &op.id);
    let item = app.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
    let remove = app.prepare_remove(&item.id).unwrap();
    app.apply_lifecycle(&remove.id).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &remove.id);
    let backup = app.backups(&item.id).unwrap().remove(0);
    app.remove_project(&project.id).unwrap();
    let restore = app.prepare_restore(&backup.id).unwrap();
    app.apply_lifecycle(&restore.id).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &restore.id);
    assert_eq!(
        app.projects()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .map(|p| &p.id)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        vec![&project.id]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        app.remove_project(&project.id).unwrap_err().code,
        "PROJECT_IN_USE"
    );
}

#[test]
fn company_flow06_remove_preserves_other_copies_and_archived_project_can_be_registered_again() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let server = MockServer::start("normal");
    let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
        &server.url,
        root.path().join("profile"),
        root.path().join("data"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let credentials = Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default());
    let app = Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config.clone(), credentials.clone()).unwrap());
    app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
    let project_root = root.path().join("Project A");
    fs::create_dir(&project_root).unwrap();
    let project = app.add_project(&project_root).unwrap();
    let global = app.prepare_install("skl_003").unwrap();
    app.confirm(&global.id, false).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &global.id);
    let project_op = app.prepare_project_install("skl_003", &project.id).unwrap();
    app.confirm(&project_op.id, false).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &project_op.id);
    let copies = app.installations().unwrap();
    let local = copies.iter().find(|i| i.project_id.is_some()).unwrap();
    let global = copies.iter().find(|i| i.project_id.is_none()).unwrap();
    let unchanged = fs::read(Path::new(&global.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        app.remove_project(&project.id).unwrap_err().code,
        "PROJECT_IN_USE"
    );
    fs::write(
        Path::new(&local.target).join("SKILL.md"),
        "Customized before remove",
    )
    .unwrap();
    let remove = app.prepare_remove(&local.id).unwrap();
    app.apply_lifecycle(&remove.id).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &remove.id);
    assert!(!Path::new(&local.target).exists());
    assert!(project_root.is_dir());
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(Path::new(&global.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap(),
        unchanged
    );
    let removed = app.refresh_installation(&local.id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(removed).unwrap()["state"], "removed");
    let backup = app.backups(&local.id).unwrap().remove(0);
    assert_eq!(backup.reason, "remove");
    app.remove_project(&project.id).unwrap();
    assert!(app.projects().unwrap().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(app.add_project(&project_root).unwrap().id, project.id);
    drop(app);
    let app = Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config, credentials).unwrap());
    let fresh = app.prepare_project_install("skl_003", &project.id).unwrap();
    app.confirm(&fresh.id, false).unwrap();
    completed(&app, &fresh.id);
    assert_eq!(
        app.prepare_restore(&backup.id).unwrap_err().code,
        "TARGET_CONFLICT"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(Path::new(&global.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap(),
        unchanged
    );
}

fn company_flow06_restore_offline_recovers_customization_and_original_baseline() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let revision = root.path().join("revision");
    fs::write(&revision, "1").unwrap();
    let mut server = MockServer::start_with_revision("normal", Some(&revision));
    let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
        &server.url,
        root.path().join("profile"),
        root.path().join("data"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let credentials = Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default());
    let app = Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config.clone(), credentials.clone()).unwrap());
    app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
    let op = app.prepare_install("skl_001").unwrap();
    app.confirm(&op.id, true).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(wait_operation(&app, &op.id)).unwrap()["state"],
        "succeeded"
    );
    let old = app.installations().unwrap().remove(0);
    fs::write(
        Path::new(&old.target).join("SKILL.md"),
        "My customized skill before update",
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(&revision, "2").unwrap();
    let update = app.prepare_update(&old.id).unwrap();
    app.confirm(&update.id, true).unwrap();
    for _ in 0..500 {
        if app.status(&update.id).unwrap().preview_ready {
            break;
        }
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20));
    }
    app.apply_update(&update.id, true).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(wait_operation(&app, &update.id)).unwrap()["state"],
        "succeeded"
    );
    let backup = app.backups(&old.id).unwrap().remove(0);
    let current = fs::read(Path::new(&old.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap();
    app.logout().unwrap();
    server.stop();
    let restore = app.prepare_restore(&backup.id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(Path::new(&old.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap(),
        current
    );
    app.apply_lifecycle(&restore.id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(wait_operation(&app, &restore.id)).unwrap()["state"],
        "succeeded"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_to_string(Path::new(&old.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap(),
        "My customized skill before update"
    );
    let restored = app.refresh_installation(&old.id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restored.package_hash, old.package_hash);
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(restored).unwrap()["contentState"],
        "customized"
    );
    assert_eq!(app.backups(&old.id).unwrap().len(), 2);
    drop(app);
    let restarted = CompanyService::new(config, credentials).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        restarted
            .refresh_installation(&old.id)
            .unwrap()
            .package_hash,
        old.package_hash
    );
    assert!(restarted.recovery_warnings().is_empty());
}
````

````rust
use super::support::MockServer;
use app_lib::core::company::{
    config::CompanyConfig, installation_service::CompanyService, session::MemoryCredentials,
};
use std::{
    fs,
    sync::Arc,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

fn wait(app: &CompanyService, id: &str) {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
    loop {
        let op = app.status(id).unwrap();
        let state = serde_json::to_value(&op).unwrap()["state"]
            .as_str()
            .unwrap()
            .to_string();
        if state == "succeeded" {
            return;
        }
        assert!(
            !matches!(state.as_str(), "failed" | "cancelled" | "recovery_required"),
            "{:?}",
            op.error
        );
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "operation timed out");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
    }
}

#[test]
fn company_flow04_projects_install_independent_copies_and_keep_metadata_after_restart() {
    let server = MockServer::start("normal");
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let config = CompanyConfig::for_test(
        &server.url,
        root.path().join("profile"),
        root.path().join("data"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let credentials = Arc::new(MemoryCredentials::default());
    let app = Arc::new(CompanyService::new(config.clone(), credentials.clone()).unwrap());
    app.login("employee01", "demo-password").unwrap();
    let a = root.path().join("Project A");
    let b = root.path().join("Project B");
    fs::create_dir(&a).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir(&b).unwrap();
    let project_a = app.add_project(&a).unwrap();
    let project_b = app.add_project(&b).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(app.add_project(&a.join(".")).unwrap().id, project_a.id);
    assert!(!a.join(".aipro").exists());
    assert!(!a.join(".claude").exists());
    let global = app.prepare_install("skl_001").unwrap();
    app.confirm(&global.id, true).unwrap();
    wait(&app, &global.id);
    for project in [&project_a, &project_b] {
        let op = app.prepare_project_install("skl_001", &project.id).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(op.mcp_path, global.mcp_path);
        app.confirm(&op.id, true).unwrap();
        wait(&app, &op.id);
    }
    let installed = app.installations().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(installed.len(), 3);
    let item_a = installed
        .iter()
        .find(|i| i.project_id.as_deref() == Some(&project_a.id))
        .unwrap();
    let target_a = std::path::Path::new(&item_a.target);
    fs::write(target_a.join("SKILL.md"), "My project A customization").unwrap();
    let refreshed = app.refresh_installation(&item_a.id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(refreshed).unwrap()["contentState"],
        "customized"
    );
    for other in installed.iter().filter(|i| i.id != item_a.id) {
        assert_ne!(
            fs::read_to_string(std::path::Path::new(&other.target).join("SKILL.md")).unwrap(),
            "My project A customization"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::to_value(app.refresh_installation(&other.id).unwrap()).unwrap()
                ["contentState"],
            "original"
        );
    }
    let original = config
        .data_root
        .join("packages")
        .join(&item_a.package_hash)
        .join("original/SKILL.md");
    assert_ne!(
        fs::read_to_string(original).unwrap(),
        "My project A customization"
    );
    let reopened = CompanyService::new(config, credentials).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(reopened.projects().unwrap().len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(reopened.installations().unwrap().len(), 3);
}
````

````rust
use std::{
    io::{BufRead, BufReader},
    process::{Child, Command, Stdio},
};

pub struct MockServer {
    child: Child,
    pub url: String,
}
impl MockServer {
    pub fn start(scenario: &str) -> Self {
        Self::start_with_revision(scenario, None)
    }
    pub fn start_with_revision(scenario: &str, revision: Option<&std::path::Path>) -> Self {
        let script = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
            .parent()
            .unwrap()
            .join("scripts/company-mock-store.mjs");
        let mut command = Command::new("node");
        command
            .arg(script)
            .args(["--port", "0", "--scenario", scenario])
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::inherit());
        if let Some(path) = revision {
            command.arg("--revision-file").arg(path);
        }
        #[cfg(windows)]
        {
            use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
            command.creation_flags(0x08000000);
        }
        let mut child = command.spawn().expect("start mock HTTP Store");
        let mut line = String::new();
        BufReader::new(child.stdout.take().unwrap())
            .read_line(&mut line)
            .unwrap();
        let url = format!(
            "http://{}",
            line.split("http://")
                .nth(1)
                .unwrap()
                .split_whitespace()
                .next()
                .unwrap()
        );
        Self { child, url }
    }
    pub fn stop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.child.kill();
        let _ = self.child.wait();
    }
}
impl Drop for MockServer {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.stop();
    }
}
````

## File: fixtures/company-store/README.md
````markdown
# Store fixtures

Synthetic development data only. No employee credentials or real MCP tokens.

The committed ZIP archives contain a root SKILL.md; excel-insights.7z contains one matching wrapper. Source text is in sources/. The mock server computes archive SHA-256 and size from the actual committed bytes, and computes an opaque strong ETag from the archive hash and full description. No sample hash is treated as a verified archive hash.

7z decoder fixtures use COPY (`excel-insights-copy.7z`), LZMA (`excel-insights-lzma.7z`) and LZMA2 (`excel-insights.7z`). The compressed fixtures contain SKILL.md plus a resource in one solid block. These were created with 7-Zip 19.00 for tests; native installation uses the bundled Rust decoder.

Demo login: employee01 (or employee02), password demo-password. Sessions are in-memory on the mock server and are invalidated by logout or server restart.

Production uses the native Rust HTTP client and the same five API endpoint contracts. The mock server is never launched automatically by the app, and production errors do not switch to fake data.

## Gói cập nhật L5

`packages/jira-project-summary-v2.zip` là ZIP thật của cùng skill Jira, gồm SKILL.md/report đã sửa và tài nguyên mới. Mock chỉ chọn gói này khi revision > 1, SHA/size/ETag được tính từ bytes thật. Dùng `--revision-file` trong integration tests hoặc `server.setRevision(2)` trong native smoke; không có endpoint admin bổ sung trong API draft.
````

````javascript
import { basename, dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'company-native-l4-l5-'));
const profile = join(root, 'profile'); const data = join(root, 'data');
const projectA = join(root, 'Project A'); const projectB = join(root, 'Project B');
await Promise.all([mkdir(join(profile, '.aipro'), { recursive: true }), mkdir(projectA), mkdir(projectB)]);

const mcpBefore = await readFile(mcp, 'utf8');
const server = createMockStore(); await new Promise(done => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', done));
const portListener = createServer(); await new Promise(done => portListener.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', done));
const port = portListener.address().port; await new Promise(done => portListener.close(done));
const env = { ...process.env, COMPANY_STORE_MODE: 'mock', COMPANY_STORE_BASE_URL: `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`, COMPANY_PROFILE_ROOT: profile, COMPANY_DATA_ROOT: data, WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS: `--remote-debugging-port=${port}` };
````

````typescript
  function toggle(id: string) { const ids = selected.includes(id) ? selected.filter(i => i !== id) : [...selected, id]; setLocalSelected(ids); onSelectionChange?.(ids); }
  function failure(e: unknown) { setError(errorMessage(e)); if (isSessionError(e)) { setOperation(undefined); setQueue([]); onExpired?.(errorMessage(e)); } }
````

````typescript
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setLoading(true); setError('');
      api.storeSearch(query, pageNumber).then(value => { if (active) setPage(value); }).catch(e => {
        if (!active) return;
        handleError(e);
      }).finally(() => { if (active) setLoading(false); });
    }, 300);
    return () => { active = false; clearTimeout(timer); };
  }, [api, query, pageNumber, handleError, revision]);

  async function openDetail(id: string) {
    selectedId.current = id;
    setError('');
    try { setDetail(await api.storeDetail(id)); }
    catch (e) { handleError(e); }
  }
  async function refreshChanged() {
    if (!detail) return;
    setOperation(undefined); setDetail(undefined);
    await openDetail(detail.id);
  }
  async function prepare() {
    if (!detail) return;
    setPreparing(true); setError('');
    try { const prepared = await (projectId ? api.prepareProjectInstallation(detail.id, projectId) : api.prepareInstallation(detail.id)); if (prepared.skill) setDetail(prepared.skill); setOperation(prepared); }
    catch (e) { handleError(e); }
    finally { setPreparing(false); }
  }

  return <>
    <div className="store-toolbar"><input aria-label="Tìm kiếm skill" placeholder="Tìm theo tên hoặc công dụng skill…" disabled={retryUntil > 0} value={query} onChange={e => { setQuery(e.target.value); setPageNumber(1); setDetail(undefined); }} /><span>{page?.pagination.total ?? 0} skill</span></div>
    {error && <div role="alert" className="error-banner">{error}{page && ' · Đang hiển thị dữ liệu lần tải trước.'}{retryUntil > 0 && ' Vui lòng chờ trước khi thử lại.'}<button disabled={retryUntil > 0} onClick={() => setRevision(value => value + 1)}>Thử lại</button></div>}
    {page?.cache?.stale && <div role="status" className="mock-banner">Dữ liệu đã lưu lúc {new Date(page.cache.fetchedAt).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}. Chưa kết nối được Store; kết nối lại để cài skill.<button onClick={() => setRevision(value => value + 1)}>Thử lại</button></div>}
    {loading && <p role="status">Đang tìm skill…</p>}
    {!loading && page?.items.length === 0 && <section className="company-card"><h2>Không tìm thấy skill</h2><p>Thử một từ khóa khác để tìm skill phù hợp.</p></section>}
    <div className="skill-grid">{page?.items.map(skill => <article className="company-card skill-card" key={skill.id}>
      <div className="skill-icon">↗</div><span className="format-tag">{skill.package.format.toUpperCase()}</span><h2>{skill.name}</h2><p>{skill.descriptionExcerpt}</p>
      <button aria-label={`Xem chi tiết ${skill.name}`} className="secondary" onClick={() => openDetail(skill.id)} disabled={loading || !!error || page.cache?.stale}>Xem chi tiết →</button>
    </article>)}</div>
    {page && page.pagination.totalPages > 1 && <div className="pagination"><button disabled={pageNumber <= 1 || loading || retryUntil > 0} onClick={() => setPageNumber(n => n - 1)}>Trang trước</button><span>{pageNumber} / {page.pagination.totalPages}</span><button disabled={pageNumber >= page.pagination.totalPages || loading || retryUntil > 0} onClick={() => setPageNumber(n => n + 1)}>Trang sau</button></div>}
    {detail && !operation && <div className="modal-overlay"><section role="dialog" aria-label="Chi tiết skill" aria-modal="true" className="company-modal"><button className="close-modal" onClick={() => { setDetail(undefined); selectedId.current = undefined; }} aria-label="Đóng chi tiết">×</button><div className="eyebrow">SKILL STORE / AIPRO</div><h2>{detail.name}</h2>
      <div className="skill-description"><ReactMarkdown skipHtml components={{ img: () => null, a: ({ children }) => <span>{children}</span> }}>{detail.description}</ReactMarkdown></div><div className="package-line">{detail.package.format.toUpperCase()} · {(detail.package.sizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KiB</div>
      <label>Phạm vi cài<select aria-label="Phạm vi cài" value={projectId} onChange={e => onProjectChange?.(e.target.value)} disabled={preparing}><option value="">AIPRO Global</option>{projects.map(p => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>Dự án: {p.name}</option>)}</select></label>
      <div className="dialog-actions"><button className="primary" disabled={preparing || !!error || page?.cache?.stale} onClick={prepare}>{preparing ? 'Đang kiểm tra…' : projectId ? 'Cài vào AIPRO Dự án' : 'Cài vào AIPRO Global'}</button></div>
    </section></div>}
    {operation && detail && <InstallDialog api={api} skill={detail} initial={operation} scopeLabel={projectId ? 'Dự án' : 'Global'} onClose={() => { setOperation(undefined); setDetail(undefined); selectedId.current = undefined; }} onRefresh={refreshChanged} onExpired={message => onExpired(message, detail.id)} onInstalled={onInstalled} />}
  </>;
}
````

## File: src/lib/presetStatus.ts
````typescript
import type { ManagedSkill, Preset } from "./tauri";

export type PresetStatus = "active" | "partial" | "inactive" | "empty";

export interface PresetStatusResult {
  status: PresetStatus;
  installed: number;
  total: number;
}

/** Granularity of the preset status tally. */
export type PresetStatusMode = "agent-pair" | "logical-skill";

/** How much of a preset is installed in the current workspace. */
export function computePresetStatus(
  preset: Preset,
  skills: ManagedSkill[],
  agentKeys: string[],
  existsInWorkspace: (skill: ManagedSkill, agentKey: string) => boolean,
  mode: PresetStatusMode = "agent-pair"
): PresetStatusResult {
  const presetSkills = skills.filter((s) => s.preset_ids.includes(preset.id));
  if (presetSkills.length === 0 || agentKeys.length === 0) {
    return { status: "empty", installed: 0, total: 0 };
  }
  if (mode === "logical-skill") {
    const total = presetSkills.length;
    let installed = 0;
    let anyCopy = false;
    for (const skill of presetSkills) {
      const deployed = agentKeys.filter((agentKey) => existsInWorkspace(skill, agentKey)).length;
      if (deployed > 0) anyCopy = true;
      if (deployed === agentKeys.length) installed++;
    }
    if (installed === total) return { status: "active", installed, total };
    // A skill that reached some of the project's agents but not all of them
    // is not installed — but it is not absent either. Reporting it inactive
    // would hide a half-applied preset behind the same grey pill as one that
    // was never applied at all.
    if (!anyCopy) return { status: "inactive", installed, total };
    return { status: "partial", installed, total };
  }

  const total = presetSkills.length * agentKeys.length;
  let installed = 0;
  for (const skill of presetSkills) {
    for (const agentKey of agentKeys) {
      if (existsInWorkspace(skill, agentKey)) installed++;
    }
  }
  if (installed === total) return { status: "active", installed, total };
  if (installed === 0) return { status: "inactive", installed, total };
  return { status: "partial", installed, total };
}
````
